17Capital is a private credit manager, specializing in NAV finance for the private equity industry. It provides non-dilutive capital to high-quality private equity management companies, funds, and institutional investors as part of their toolkit for value creation and portfolio management.

Founded in 2008, 17Capital has completed over 130 investments, deploying more than $20 billion alongside leading private equity franchises globally.

For more information, please go to www.17capital.com

17Capital’s Values

Our values are the basis on which we build strong relationships with our clients, our investors and each other. They are the foundation of our business and integral to our continued ability to pioneer success.

Build trust – We behave and act in ways that earn trust

Embrace “different” – We embrace new ideas and constantly strive to discover new ways of doing things

Make things happen – We are agile and responsive in a way that delivers success for all our stakeholders

Strive for excellence – We act with professionalism and adhere to our high standard

Overview

17Capital’s Client Service team is looking to hire an Analyst to join their team in London to continue to drive the rapid growth of this area and the firm. * Support the preparation of materials for investor reporting
* Support the management of the investor portal and fundraising data rooms
* Provide hands-on support to the existing investor base and respond to investor requests and queries
* Utilise AI tools and data analytics to streamline processes, automate routine tasks and where relevant, generate data-driven insights for the team

Skills and Experience

* A team player who can work in a collaborative, dynamic environment
* Strong financial and analytical skills
* Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written
* A strong work ethic and someone who can take ownership of their work whilst demonstrating a high level of attention to detail
* Able to demonstrate honesty, integrity, and professionalism
* Strong academics and a background in financial services is preferred
* Strong organisational and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

* Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity tools (e.g. Microsoft Copilot, Claude) to improve efficiency and support day-to-day tasks

We offer you:

* Opportunity to learn and grow whilst making a meaningful contribution to the continued expansion of 17Capital during an exciting time of the firm’s overall growth

Are you a Test Applications engineer who loves solving complex technical challenges and shaping real‑world products?
 
As a Test Applications Developer at A-Safe you will design, develop, and maintain software for controlling production test equipment of A-Safe’s Electronic Products.
A-Safe is a global leader in polymer safety barriers with an ambitious roadmap to expand its technology offering. As part of the embedded systems team you will be integral in delivering this roadmap.
 
How you will make an impact:

 * Maintain existing production applications for Automated PCB testing, End of Line Testing.
 * Design and develop applications for testing new products are they come to fruition.
 * Analyse Test data to ensure test procedures are optimized and efficient.  Leading production reviews to ensure quality is maintained.
 * Collaborate with Electronic and Mechanical teams to ensure suitability of test apparatus.
 * Perform and review testing, validation, and debugging of new product developments.
 * Prepare and review technical documentation, including specifications and test reports to a professional standard.

 What we are looking for:

 * Strong communication skills with an enthusiasm for collaboration.
 * Innovative mindset and willingness to learn new technologies.
 * Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
 * Detail-oriented with a focus on quality.
 * Degree in Software Engineering or related discipline.
 * Strong experience of test Applications, preferably C# language.
 * Experience with electronic test equipment control e.g. Power Supplies, Digital Multi-Meter, Spectrum Analyser, NI-DAQ etc 
 * Understanding of Test methodologies, scientific approach, and mathematical reasoning.
 * Experience with Jira task management, and Github release management.
 * Familiarity with LabVIEW would be a bonus.

 
You’ll also bring:

 * A problem‑solving mindset and the confidence to challenge assumptions.
 * High attention to detail and strong ownership of design quality.
 * Curiosity, adaptability and a willingness to explore new technologies and techniques.
 * A collaborative approach — you’ll work across multiple disciplines daily.
 * The desire to build products that genuinely improve safety and efficiency in industrial environments.

Why you’ll love working with us: 
You’ll join a highly capable, friendly and passionate engineering team where your ideas make an immediate impact. You’ll work on meaningful, real‑world products used by global brands from airports and warehouses to manufacturing sites worldwide.  You’ll help shape next‑generation connected safety technology in a business that values innovation, invests in R&D, and embraces engineering excellence. Expect variety, autonomy, technical challenge and a supportive environment where good engineering truly matters.  If you enjoy building hardware that solves real problems and want to be part of a team pushing the boundaries of industrial IoT, this role is for you.  
Benefits:

 * A subsidised on-site gym, available for all colleagues. 
 * Flexible start and finish times to fit around you and your lifestyle.
 * Enhanced Maternity, Paternity and NICU pay. 
 * 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays with the option to buy more 
 * Cycle to work scheme, Specsavers vouchers, long service rewards, EAP

For more information on our benefits, please see our benefits booklet. 

About us: Our story started in 1984, when A-SAFE set out to solve real workplace safety problems with better, more innovative products. Today, our solutions protect people, assets and operations for brands globally.  We remain a family-owned business, built on strong values and long-term relationships. If you want to know what we stand for, you can learn more about our story and values.   

Our HQ in Elland, Halifax, is home to cutting-edge manufacturing technology and modern offices that reflect the quality of what we do. You can take a virtual look around with our 3D tour.   A-SAFE has grown organically over the years and now supports more than 6,000 customers across 50 countries. We are proud to work with global names such as Amazon, Coca Cola and BMW. AALTO, a global leader in Stratospace. Based in Farnborough, AALTO is an Airbus subsidiary that manufactures, operates, and delivers services with its solar-powered, stratospheric platform: Zephyr.
Zephyr’s persistence enables continuous flight for months at a time. Its current flight-time record of over 67 days in the stratosphere. From above 60,000+ft, or 20km above ground, AALTO can deliver several applications including direct-to-device connectivity and high-resolution Earth observation.
AALTO operates in a new operational layer between most of air traffic and low-Earth orbit, Stratospace. This is where high-altitude platforms led by Zephyr deliver services to commercial and government partners. We can help monitor environments, observe borders, track natural disasters and connect unconnected communities.
Join us as we create a new domain of aerospace: Stratospace. You’ll be part of a highly-skilled, innovative and passionate group of people – Team AALTO. Together, we can Unlock Stratospace.
About The Role
As a Software Engineer, you’ll develop robust, safety-critical software for airborne systems, working hands-on with complex engineering challenges where quality, reliability and precision matter.
You’ll work primarily in C, with opportunities to use C++ and Python, contributing across requirements, design, implementation, integration, verification and qualification. This is a role for someone who enjoys solving real-world engineering problems, collaborating across disciplines and seeing their work progress from concept through to aircraft-level application.
If you’re motivated by meaningful technical work, high standards and the opportunity to contribute to pioneering aerospace programmes, this is a chance to make a visible impact in a highly collaborative engineering environment.
Responsibilities to include:
· Design, develop, test and maintain high-quality software for safety-critical airborne systems, primarily using C, with C++ and Python where appropriate.
· Contribute across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements capture and design through to implementation, integration, verification and qualification.
· Work closely with Systems, Hardware, Test and Flight Operations teams to solve aircraft-level challenges and deliver integrated engineering solutions.
· Support software integration, debugging, test automation and evidence generation for qualification and certification activities.
· Participate in technical reviews, challenge assumptions constructively and help strengthen engineering best practice.
· Contribute to a culture of technical excellence, accountability and continuous improvement.
Skills and Knowledge Required
· Practical software engineering experience, ideally including 3+ years in aerospace or another safety-critical environment.
· Experience contributing to airborne software development within a DO-178C environment, including requirements, design, implementation, integration and verification.
· Strong C programming skills, with experience in C++ and Python.
· Experience working with embedded, real-time or resource-constrained software systems.
· Familiarity with software requirements management, verification, traceability and configuration management processes.
· Strong problem-solving, debugging and analytical skills, with the ability to work methodically through complex technical issues.
· A collaborative communication style and the confidence to work effectively with engineers from multiple disciplines.
· Awareness of related standards such as DO-330, DO-331, DO-332, DO-333, ARP4754A/B, DO-278, DEF STAN 00-55 or DEF STAN 00-56 would be advantageous.
Why This Role Stands Out
· You’ll work on meaningful software that directly supports advanced aircraft systems.
· You’ll be part of a multidisciplinary engineering team where software, hardware, systems and operations come together.
· You’ll have the opportunity to broaden your technical expertise across safety-critical development, verification and certification.
· You’ll see the impact of your work in a challenging, innovative and fast-moving aerospace environment.
In addition to an attractive market-aligned salary, we offer:
Rewarding Excellence: Benefit from our short-term incentive plan that rewards your hard work and dedication.
Enjoy Your Time Off: Benefit from 25 days of holiday to relax and recharge.
Stay Healthy: We’ve got your health covered with private medical insurance, along with dental and optical cash back.
Secure Your Future: Take advantage of our personal pension plan to ensure a comfortable retirement.
Peace of Mind: Our income protection and life assurance schemes are there to support you when you need it most.
Getting around: Drive the latest vehicles with our discounted salary sacrifice scheme.
We Care About You: Our employee assistance programme is always available to provide the support you need.
Perks Galore: Enjoy a range of employee discounts via Perkbox, from household goods to travel!
Does this opportunity excite you but you’re not 100% sure if you meet all the requirements for the role? Or are you concerned that ‘normal’ office hours aren’t possible given your personal circumstances? Whilst we can’t accommodate every flexible working request, we’ll try to find a practical solution. So why not engage with us and find out more about this role?
If this role isn’t quite what you’re looking for but are keen to be contacted about opportunities at AALTO, you can register your details here: https://careers.aaltohaps.com/connect

Working closely with the senior leadership team, you will develop the data strategy, strengthen the underlying platform and introduce reporting, automation and analytical solutions that improve commercial decision-making and operational performance.

This is not purely a strategic leadership role. The successful person will be comfortable setting the direction while remaining sufficiently hands-on to understand the technology, solve problems and help establish the capability from the ground up.

The role

Your responsibilities will include:

* Creating and delivering a practical data and analytics strategy that supports the organisation’s wider growth plans.
* Improving the quality, structure and accessibility of data held across different business systems.
* Developing a modern, secure and scalable data environment, including data pipelines, integrations, storage and modelling.
* Producing meaningful dashboards and management information that give senior leaders a clearer view of performance, trends and commercial opportunities.

* Building and developing a data and analytics team as the function grows.
* Over time, helping the business explore how its data expertise could be developed into services for external clients.

We are looking for an experienced data leader who combines strong commercial judgement with credible technical knowledge.

* Previous experience leading a data, analytics, business intelligence or data engineering function.
* A track record of developing data capability within an organisation, rather than simply maintaining an established function.
* Strong experience of business intelligence and visualisation, ideally including Power BI.
* Good working knowledge of SQL and modern data architecture.
* Experience within a cloud-based data environment, ideally Microsoft Azure.
* An understanding of data engineering, including ingestion, transformation, modelling, pipelines and storage.
* Exposure to workflow automation or low-code tools such as Power Automate, Power Apps or comparable technologies.
* Experience improving CRM platforms, integrations and the quality of customer or client data.
* The ability to translate technical information into clear commercial recommendations.
* Confidence working with board-level and senior operational stakeholders.
* A collaborative, pragmatic approach, with the willingness to remain involved in delivery.
* Experience recruiting, managing or developing a data and analytics team.

Brook Rural Museum is entering a pivotal new chapter, having secured initial development funding of £218,000 from The National Lottery Heritage Fund for a project that will help safeguard the Museum’s future.

The Museum is now seeking an experienced Capital Project Manager to help shape and lead the project’s Development Phase from September 2026 until planned submission of a full grant application for £1,468,000 in November 2027.  Reappointment for the Delivery Phase will be subject to the Museum securing the full grant from the Heritage Fund and required match funding,  as well as satisfactory performance in the Development Phase.

Set in the small village of Brook, in the heart of the beautiful Kent Downs National Landscape, the Museum occupies a magnificent Grade I barn and Grade II oast house containing a collection of farming and rural implements, offering visitors vivid insights into rural life in the horse-drawn age.

Urgent work is needed to address issues of damp and pest control and  safeguard both the historic buildings and the Museum’s collection. Job Title: Project Curator

Salary: £38,049

Hours: Full time

Terms: Fixed term up to 2 years with potential to extend subject to funding

Location: The Almonry, Evesham, Worcestershire

An exciting opportunity has arisen to join The Almonry Museum for The National Lottery Heritage Fund ‘Re-Imagining the Almonry’ Development Phase as the **Curator**.

We are looking for an experienced curator to embark on an exciting project to completely re-interpret and re-display the stories of Evesham and the Almonry. Responsibilities include reviewing the Collection Development Policy, advising on the implementation of a Digital Asset Management System (DAMS), coordinating conservation audits and funding applications, appointing external conservators where required, and ensuring collections care standards are met throughout interpretation and exhibition design. The postholder will also contribute to wider project planning, evaluation and activity development, recruit and manage volunteers, and help secure additional funding to support project delivery, while contributing to the development and delivery of a Delivery Phase application to The National Lottery Heritage Fund.

* Allocate work across the Technical Manager, Airworthiness / Technical Review Engineers and Technical Coordinator.

* Hold the technical team accountable for delivery of assigned aircraft, engine, component, transition, acquisition, return, inspection and technical project workstreams.

* Ensure material projects have clear scope, milestones, supplier responsibilities, internal owners, decision points and reporting cadence.

* Review weekly project updates before escalation to the Head of Technical.

* Monitor performance of MROs, OEMs, CAMO providers, inspection providers, records providers, engine shops, consultants and subcontractors across active projects.

* Coach and develop Airworthiness / Technical Review Engineers toward future Technical Manager capability.

* Ensure the Technical Coordinator maintains effective meeting discipline, document control, workflow tracking, action logs, project administration and reporting support.

* Act as deputy operational lead for the department during Head of Technical travel, leave or senior external commitments.

* Clear allocation of work by owner, due date and escalation route.

* Monthly project delivery/status summary.

## Clinical Seating Engineer

**Active Design****Role: Clinical Seating Engineer  
Benefits: Free on-site parking, Legal and General pension contributions, 27 days annual leave with increase to 29 and 33 days with continuous service, paid sick leave with continuous service, Employee Assistant programme**

Active Design is leading manufacturer of wheelchair special seating products and clinical seating services. The company has been involved in the design, development and manufacturer of postural management equipment for over 30 years. Our products are manufactured at our factory in Aston, Birmingham using a wide range of production techniques.

**What we are looking for:**

We are seeking to recruit an enthusiastic Clinical Seating Engineer that will prescribe seating systems which are shaped individually to service users, most of whom will have complex needs, based on clinical data gathered at assessment and the response of the person to the supporting surface.  They will work in conjunction with the wheelchair service clinicians to develop optimised support for the individual.  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manipulating the material directly to the service user
* Capturing a shape using vacuum consolidation bead bags
* Manufacturing a bespoke tubular framework to support the cellular structure and interfacing this to wheelchair bases
* Adapting/modifying equipment to meet specific needs
* Creating bespoke solutions where off-the-shelf equipment cannot be obtained to meet the person’s needs
* Handing over the completed system to the service user
* Making further adjustments to the system over time to allow for growth or changing need.

The role requires integration of clinical and technical knowledge with practical application, taking account of the service user’s functional needs, which often conflict with their postural requirements, and the fact that people can present differently on different days and that factors beyond their control have an influence on their ability to tolerate/respond to a seating system.

Whilst responsibility for the individual’s episode of care lies with the local clinician, the post holder is responsible for ensuring that the needs of the individual are met in an effective and safe manner.  As an autonomous practitioner you will:

1. Be managed, rather than supervised; results/outcomes are assessed at agreed intervals through clinical supervision; this will be guided by precedent and policy
2. Provide high quality, service user focused assessment and prescription of wheelchair seating, also including manual wheelchairs, powered wheelchairs and buggies
3. Work within professional and regulatory standards, and clinical/technical guidelines, promoting best practice and undertaking all aspects of clinical and technical duties
4. Provide specialist clinical and technical advice to other members of the team and contribute to the development of clinical and technical services
5. Possess expertise within the specialism of wheelchair services, underpinned by developed clinical and technical theoretical knowledge and experience
6. Regularly perform development work in relation to service user specific clinical/technical requirements
7. Plan and deliver training sessions for health and social care professionals

The job holder will work in a variety of settings including clinics, community centres, and service users’ homes according to service requirements.  In addition, they will participate in clinical governance activity, including CPD and developing and implementing quality improvements within the service.

We are looking for someone to work 40 hours per week Monday to Thursday between 8am to 5pm with a half hour unpaid lunch break and 2 x 15-minute breaks (paid) and Fridays 7am – 1pm. This role can be home based but with the understanding that requirement to attend clinics around the South and South East region and be out in the community plays a big part of the role and therefore you must also hold a valid UK driving license with no more then 6 points on.

You're an experienced infrastructure professional who brings both depth of technical knowledge and the mindset of a trusted colleague. * The discipline to work within ITSM frameworks and the rigour to maintain accurate configuration and asset data.
* Experience working alongside a Managed Service Provider as part of an augmented team, including managing service quality and accountability.
* A track record of producing documentation that works for diverse audiences — runbooks, procedures, service improvement write-ups.

* Bringing energy and expertise to a team that genuinely wants to do good work together.

In addition to this, you should have a creative flair to take the Butternut brand and make it shine through your team.

This is a hybrid role, where you'll need to be at the Box Office in White City, London, at least three days a week, with regular travel to other Butternut locations, including internationally.

**❓ What you'll do**

* Lead our UK&I Customer Love team, keeping eNPS at a world-class level and ensuring the team is happy, engaged and set up to succeed.

* Work with tools including Intercom, Iterable and AgoraPulse to deliver an excellent customer experience.
* Build new procedures and structures for the team, including with AI tools, staying curious about better ways of working and bringing your team along with you.
* Present regularly at Customer Love all-hands meetings, in person and virtually, delivering clear messages that inspire the wider team.

* You're adaptable, comfortable changing direction as circumstances shift.

**At AQA, we’re committed to advancing education and we’re committed to our people. As the largest provider of academic qualifications in the UK, we mark over 10 million exam papers each year and it’s our people who make this happen.**

**Senior Strategy Manager, Education & Assessment Reform**

**Permanent | Full Time**  
**Manchester: £64,600 - £74,100**  
**Guildford / London: £67,200 - £77,200**

**Hybrid Working**

**Help shape the future of qualifications**

The education landscape is changing.

 

Curriculum reform, evolving customer expectations, advances in assessment technology and a rapidly changing policy environment are creating significant opportunities and challenges for awarding organisations.

 

This is your opportunity to help shape the response.

 

As Senior Strategy Manager, you'll play a key role in defining how AQA's qualifications evolve in response to reform. Working at the heart of our Product Management function, you'll help translate complex educational, market and policy developments into practical strategies that support schools, colleges, teachers and learners across the UK.

 

This is a rare opportunity to influence decisions at a national scale whilst working alongside senior leaders across the organisation to shape the future direction of qualifications.

 

**What you'll be doing**

You'll contribute to the development and delivery of AQA's assessment reform strategy, helping to ensure our products continue to meet the needs of customers, learners and the wider education sector. Your work will include:

* Shaping strategic thinking on complex education and qualification reform issues
* Supporting the development of long-term qualification and product strategies
* Using insight, evidence and research to inform recommendations and decision making
* Developing approaches to product prioritisation, planning and performance measurement
* Bringing together stakeholders from across the organisation to build alignment and momentum
* Translating strategic direction into practical actions and deliverable plans
* Identifying opportunities to innovate and respond to developments across education and assessment

 

You'll regularly work with senior stakeholders, influencing decisions, navigating ambiguity and helping the organisation make evidence-based choices in a fast-changing environment.

 

**You'll thrive in this role if you have:**

* Experience shaping strategy, products, programmes or large-scale change.
* The ability to turn complex information into clear, practical recommendations.
* Confidence working through ambiguity and using evidence and insight to inform decisions.
* Demonstrable stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and build alignment.
* Excellent analytical thinking, collaboration and sound judgement.
* An in-depth understanding of the education system in England.
* Experience gained within education, educational publishing, assessment, curriculum, product management, policy, strategy, transformation or a similarly complex environment.

 

**Why join us?**

Few organisations have the opportunity to influence education at the scale that AQA does.

This role offers the chance to contribute to one of the most significant periods of change the qualifications sector has experienced in decades. You'll help shape decisions that impact learners, teachers and education providers across the country while working alongside colleagues who are passionate about improving education.

You'll influence long-term strategy, work across a broad range of stakeholders and play a meaningful role in helping AQA navigate a complex and evolving landscape.

 

**What's in it for you?**

* A unique opportunity to influence qualification and assessment reform at a national level.
* Exposure to senior leaders and strategic decision-making across AQA.
* The chance to shape long-term product and qualification strategy.
* A varied role combining strategy, insight, stakeholder engagement and implementation.
* A 35-hour working week with flexible, hybrid working.
* 25 days' annual leave, rising to 30 days, plus Christmas closure days.
* A benefits package including a pension with combined contributions of up to 18.5%, healthcare support, wellbeing programmes and volunteering opportunities.
* The opportunity to be part of AQA's inclusive and values-led culture, with access to a range of employee networks and communities.

 

**What's next?**

To apply, please upload your CV together with a short supporting statement outlining:

* Why you're interested in this opportunity.
* The experience and skills you would bring to the role.
* How your background would help you contribute to AQA's assessment reform strategy

**Applications close at 23:59 on Sunday 23 August 2026.**

The selection process is expected to include:

* A short screening call with a recruiter.
* A first-stage Teams interview during the week commencing 31 August 2026.
* A final face-to-face interview during the week commencing 7 September 2026.

Further details, including interview preparation materials, will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

 

**Diversity and Inclusion Statement**

At AQA, we are committed to fostering a workplace that celebrates diversity and promotes equity and inclusion. We believe that a diverse team brings richer perspectives and drives better outcomes. Our ED&I strategy ensures that everyone, regardless of religion, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, age, disability, sexual orientation or background, is valued, respected and empowered to thrive. We actively promote inclusive language, avoid stereotypes and strive for representation across all dimensions of diversity. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and lived experiences.

# **Full Job Description**

**Summary**

Purpose:  
The Senior Manager – Reform Strategy is responsible for contributing to the development of AQA’s GQ reform strategy. Working closely with the Head of Reform Strategy and leaders across the organisation, they’ll be an important part of the team responsible for developing AQA’s overarching GQ reform strategy. Contributing to providing a clear and coherent vision and strategic intent, they’ll develop positions on cross-cutting strategic issues and support the development of effective subject strategies.  
  
They will act as a central authority on our products and assessment reform best practice, fostering organisational knowledge and capability through collaboration with internal stakeholders. Taking the lead on key elements of the strategic framework from inception to implementation, they’ll influence organisational decisions and ensure co-ordination with other strategic priorities and programmes.  
  
This role will report to the Head of Reform Strategy and will work closely with senior managers and Heads of Product across Product Management and with the Qualifications Development team as well as leaders and teams across the wider business. They will work with the Senior Manager – Assessment Reform Communications to support the development of internal culture. They may also represent the organisation with external stakeholders as required.Landscape:  
The Senior Manager – Reform Strategy will be part of a focused Assessment Reform Strategy team within the wider Product Management team. They’ll be working alongside a team of Heads of Product, Subject Sector Leads and Product Managers and will need to work closely with the Qualifications Development team and Quality and Accreditation colleagues.  
  
They’ll need to clearly communicate with authority our reform strategy across the business and understand its impact on the priorities of different business areas, including but not limited to Assessment, Operational delivery, Finance, Assessment Technology and Commercial teams.  
Understanding the opportunities and constraints of a regulated environment will be critical and they are likely to engage with external stakeholders across both customer and policy-related audiences.  
  
Activities:  
Strategy development  
Make a significant contribution to the development of GQ reform strategy for AQA, leading the development of aspects of the strategy and its implementation.  
Substantially support Product leads to develop effective subject strategies, providing alignment and sharing best practice across subjects to ensure maximisation of commercial opportunities and coherence in the AQA product offer across subjects.  
Develop thinking and implementable planning on cross-cutting themes and issues such as product prioritisation, pricing and target setting.  
Work as part of the team delivering cross-portfolio development of a holistic baseline and enhanced product offer  
Leadership and management  
Influence and engage with a wide range of stakeholders across the organisation, often in senior roles, working outside direct vertical line management structures.  
Credibly represent AQA with external stakeholders as necessary.  
Data and evidence  
Provide the evidence that underpins our reform strategy, using data, market insight and research as required.  
Product design  
Deliver cross-portfolio high-level product design, working with colleagues to agree the core elements that will underpin all reform qualifications.  
Cross-team working and collaboration  
Work closely with colleagues in the PMO to ensure that programme plans reflect the deliverables necessary to implement the strategy.  
Balance our product strategies with regulatory requirements, customer and commercial and internal drivers  
Consider the impact of product decisions on our wider commercial landscape and our GTM approach.  
Continuous improvement and feedback integration  
Ensure our reform strategies are regularly reviewed, managing feedback from stakeholders and considering the impact on other strategic deliverables.  
Technology and innovation  
Ensure product and reform strategies are aligned with wider advances in technology and that they reflect any innovations in the assessment market.  
  
To be successful in this role, you will need to demonstrate:  
Essential criteria:  
Proven ability to work in challenging and time-sensitive contexts, working with uncertainty and in a changing external environment.  
Ability to provide effective leadership, managing matrix-teams and working outside direct vertical line management structures.  
Strong collaborative skills and ability to influence without authority.  
Strong understanding of data and evidence and how this can contribute to the development of strategy.  
Experience of influencing and engaging senior internal stakeholders, including strong communication skills.  
Knowledge of AQA’s market context, customers and competitors.  
Excellent planning, analytical, and organisational skills.  
Ability to manage complex projects with multiple stakeholders and dependencies.  
Experience working in a regulated or educational environment.  
Experience of product development.  
Understanding of AQA’s expertise and capabilities.  
Proven ability to cut through blockages to decision-making or delivery, working with other colleagues to find effective solutions quickly

As a Customer Insight Analyst, you'll help AQA better understand its customers by turning information from multiple sources into clear, actionable insight.  
This is more than a reporting role. You'll look beyond the data to identify patterns, explore underlying causes and build a deeper understanding of customer needs and experiences. •    Creating dashboards, reports and accessible data visualisations that give stakeholders practical insight and recommendations.  
•    Working with teams across AQA to understand their questions, challenge assumptions and influence decisions through trusted evidence and customer insight.

•    Experience using quantitative and qualitative research methods to analyse information and generate actionable insight.  
•    The ability to handle large or complex datasets while continuing to question what the information means and what else needs to be understood.  
•    Experience presenting complex findings clearly through reports, dashboards, visualisations or data storytelling.  
•    Confidence advising and influencing stakeholders through evidence-based recommendations.  
•    A proactive and adaptable approach, with the ability to work effectively when processes or information are still developing.

•    Influence decisions that affect AQA’s customers, products and future direction.  
•    Explore different sources of customer and competitor information.

# **Full Job Description**

**Summary**

The Customer Intelligence team’s mission is to influence AQA to make confident decisions because we understand customers better than anyone else. We strive to be the exam board of choice. We do this by delivering the right insights, at the right time, to allow us to better understand our customers, the market and our future potential. Stakeholders will receive trustworthy data and meaningful insights to inform decision making and agree prioritised areas for development and improvement.  
  
The Customer Insight Analyst plays a key role in supporting this mission by uncovering actionable customer insights from data to inform strategic decisions and improve customer experiences. The insights provided by the Customer Insight Analyst will help drive product development, strategic decisions, and will help shape the future direction of our organisation.  
  
In this role you will use expertise in data analytics and direct feedback received from customer facing teams and colleagues to develop insight about customers that aligns to the needs of our insight delivery plan and Customer Intelligence team accountabilities.  
  
As part of a small insight team you will work with appropriate AQA departments to turnaround valuable insight that helps our leadership team make key decisions.AQA is a leading exam board and education charity. As well as delivering high quality assessment, we believe it is vital that we use our research, insight and expertise to support strategic decision making. The Customer Intelligence team works across all areas of the organisation providing insights, guidance and supporting improvement efforts to ensure our customers are kept front and centre in everything we do. The postholder will be used to working in a fast-paced environment delivering clear actionable insight and recommendations for AQA.   
  
Activities:  
•    Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs and challenges and translate them into analytical questions.  
•    Develop and maintain dashboards and reports that provide clear, actionable insights.  
•    Conduct in-depth analysis to identify trends, anomalies, and recommend opportunities for improvement.  
•    Analysing data sets of multiple types (research, behavioural, panel) to find insight about our customers that we can act on. You will be accountable for digesting several sources of information into cohesive narratives.  
•    Using expertise to produce accurate and actionable insight which develops and drives action in support of our Brand and Customer Strategy.   
•    Work closely with other analysts, and insight roles, and the Customer Intelligence Business Partner to devise the best approaches and methods for our analysis.    
•    Work with colleagues across the Customer Intelligence Team to help support the development of future tools and capabilities being developed.   
•    Develop and maintain strong working relationships with other AQA teams who have an interest and / or influence in Customer and Product systems or information, e.g. AQA CRM team or AQA Data Analytics Insight and Reporting team.

•    Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement and customer-centric thinking across the organisation providing data and insight to support the journey towards increased customer centricity.   
•    Contribute to strategic planning and decision-making processes by providing data-driven insights and recommendations.  
•    Ensure data accuracy and compliance with relevant regulations and policies.

•    A degree or other relevant qualification (such as an apprenticeship) in a relevant field   
•    Proven experience of delivering research projects independently, preferably in an education-related or assessment-related context.  
•    Strong understanding of education policy issues and trends.  
•    Experience of using appropriate quantitative and qualitative methodologies for analysis and insight, including statistical data analysis, data visualisations, surveys, interviews and focus groups.

* Delivery and Impact: Translate scientific creativity into tangible pipeline assets and platform innovations that increase probability of technical success and shorten time to patient benefit.

Define and maintain the enterprise data architecture, including target-state designs, roadmaps, and architectural standards and patterns.

Experience with data governance frameworks and tools (e.g. Microsoft Purview), data quality management, metadata, and lineage tooling.
Strong SQL and working knowledge of Python and/or Spark.

## Job description

We are growing our scientific team at ExpressionEdits and are offering an opportunity to join us in a full-time role as a Senior/Principal Scientist, Protein Sciences based at our laboratories in the Babraham Research Campus near Cambridge.

About ExpressionEdits:

At ExpressionEdits, we are revolutionizing biotechnology to create therapeutics that nobody else can. We have gone back to the basic building block of the field, the transgene, which has remained essentially stagnant since the 1970s, and re-invented its design based on our proprietary method of intronization.

With this technology, we can turn the artificial transgenes of the past into sequences that incorporate both coding and non-coding DNA to express more effectively, while also looking more like a cell’s natural genes. We believe this approach, guided by our artificial intelligence “Engine” for genetic design, will allow us to bring forth the full potential of genetic production.

We are a growing startup company within Cambridge’s synthetic biology community which you can join as an early member of our diverse team that spans biology, engineering, data science, and operations. With your help, we can bring our vision of ‘building biology like nature’ to life.

Position overview:

This is a senior, hands-on laboratory role responsible for the expression, purification and analytical characterisation of recombinant proteins - including antibodies and other therapeutic biologics - to support preclinical drug discovery. The Senior/Principal Scientist will bring deep technical expertise in mammalian (CHO/HEK) expression and protein engineering, working across teams to exemplify and advance the company's intron technology platform. The role holder will independently lead purification work, generate high-quality analytical data to support programme decisions, and act as a technical reference point for less experienced scientists in the team.

Responsibilities

· Recombinant Protein Expression:

Design, execute and optimise recombinant protein expression in mammalian systems (CHO and HEK), including transient and stable formats, for antibodies and other therapeutic proteins.

Apply protein engineering principles, assessing structure-function relationships, to inform construct design and troubleshoot poorly expressing or unstable molecules; exposure to computational modelling to support this work would be an advantage.

· Purification, Analytics and Quality:

Independently plan and execute protein purification workflows from milligram to gram scale, using the AKTA chromatography platform (including the AKTA avant) across multiple modes of chromatography (e.g. Protein A/affinity, ion exchange, size exclusion).

Maintain working knowledge of scale-up and technology transfer to CDMOs, and of the stages toward IND filing for a biologic, so that preclinical work anticipates downstream manufacturability needs.

Design and perform analytical characterisation (e.g. HPLC-based methods such as SEC, RP, IEX) to support preclinical QC release and characterisation packages, such as stability studies.

Maintain rigorous documentation in line with good scientific and record-keeping practice, ensuring data is fit for use in regulatory and IP contexts.

· Technical Leadership and Collaboration

Act as a technical expert and point of reference for protein expression, purification and analytics, supporting and mentoring more junior scientists.

Qualifications, experience and skills:

Qualifications and Experience:

Essential:

PhD in a relevant discipline (e.g. biochemistry, molecular biology, protein science) would be ideal; equivalent industry experience will also be considered.

Hands-on experience of recombinant protein expression in CHO and/or HEK systems, including transfection (e.g. transient transfection for HEK, stable pool/cell line generation for CHO), and of protein engineering with a good understanding of structure-function relationships.

Experience working on antibodies or other therapeutic recombinant proteins within a biotech (or equivalent industry) environment.

Direct experience of protein purification to gram scale, including hands-on use of the AKTA chromatography platform, ideally the AKTA avant.

Experience with HPLC and other protein analytical techniques used for QC purposes.

Comfortable in a role that is predominantly laboratory-based.

Desirable:

Experience of technology transfer to CDMOs, and understanding of the stages toward IND filing for a biologic.

Knowledge or experience of SEC-MALS, mass spectrometry, DLS, CE-SDS, Biacore/SPR (binding kinetics), or cell-based potency assays, particularly mass spectrometry.

Exposure to computational modelling to support protein engineering.

Experience designing and running protein stability studies (e.g. thermal, freeze-thaw, forced degradation) to support candidate selection and characterisation packages.

Knowledge or experience of cell line development, and broader awareness of biologics drug discovery.

Skills & Attributes:

Strong scientific integrity and attention to detail.

Excellent organisational skills.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with other team members.

Highly organized, proactive, adaptable with the ability to multitask effectively in a fast-paced laboratory environment.

Strong communication and teamwork skills, fostering collaboration across teams.

Flexible and solutions-orientated approach to work; ability to support colleagues and prioritize tasks based on shifting company priorities.

Desire to continuous learning and professional growth; eager to develop new skills in alignment with the company’s scientific advancements.

* Assisting in the operation and optimisation of IDAM services across on‐premise and cloud environments
* Working with colleagues to embed secure-by-design principles into technology solutions

Our technology is already used by major events, venues, festivals, sports clubs and hospitality organisations around the world, including Live Nation, ASM Global, Oak View Group, LIV Golf, Diageo and Guinness, Levy, Sodexo, Peppermint, Freemans Event Partners, PSG, AEG Presents, Parklife Festival, London Stadium, Birmingham City FC, Ibiza Rocks, Co-op Live, Adelaide Oval and many more.

We are entering an exciting phase of national and international growth and are looking for practical, reliable people who are excited by technology, hospitality and delivering an excellent customer experience.

## **About the Role**

At Boxbar, we believe in delivering perfect dispense quality at speed. Our Draught Dispense Technicians play an important role in making that happen.

You will help build, test and refurbish Boxbar machines and draught dispense systems at our Wakefield workshop. You will also travel to customer venues to support installations, commissioning, servicing, maintenance and repairs.

Working alongside experienced colleagues and technical leads, you will help ensure our equipment is installed correctly, operates reliably and consistently delivers excellent drinks quality.

This is a hands-on position suited to someone with practical draught dispense, mechanical, electrical or technical experience who enjoys solving problems and working across workshop and customer-site environments.

## **Key Responsibilities**

### **Workshop Builds and Preparation**

* Assemble, build and test draught dispense systems and Boxbar equipment.
* Refurbish and prepare machines for installation or deployment.
* Follow technical instructions, build specifications and quality standards.
* Complete pre-deployment checks and identify any faults or missing components.
* Maintain a clean, safe and organised workshop environment.

### **Installation and Commissioning**

* Support the installation of draught dispense equipment at venues, stadiums, arenas and hospitality locations.
* Install and connect dispense components, pipework, cooling equipment and related systems.
* Commission equipment to ensure consistent drinks quality from keg to tap.
* Complete system testing before customer handover.
* Work with colleagues, contractors and venue teams to deliver installations safely and efficiently.

### **Maintenance and Servicing**

* Carry out planned maintenance and servicing of Boxbar and draught dispense equipment.
* Diagnose and resolve mechanical, electrical and dispense-related faults.
* Identify signs of wear, damage or reliability issues before they become more serious.
* Complete repairs to a high standard and minimise repeat service visits.
* Escalate complex technical issues to the Workshop Manager or Technical Lead where appropriate.

### **Customer and Venue Support**

* Represent Boxbar professionally while working at customer locations.
* Explain the correct operation, cleaning and basic care of installed systems.
* Provide practical guidance to venue teams to help maintain dispense quality.
* Communicate clearly with clients and internal teams regarding progress, faults and completed work.
* Help deliver a positive and reliable experience for Boxbar’s customers and partners.

### **Documentation and Compliance**

* Complete installation reports, service records, job sheets and technical documentation accurately.
* Record equipment faults, repairs, parts used and follow-up actions.
* Follow Boxbar’s health and safety procedures and customer-site requirements.
* Ensure tools, equipment and company vehicles are used safely and responsibly.
* Raise risks, delays or technical concerns promptly with the relevant manager.

### **Continuous Improvement**

* Share practical ideas that could improve builds, installations, servicing or reliability.
* Support the development of clearer workshop and field processes.
* Apply lessons learned from previous installations and service visits.
* Take part in relevant technical, product and health and safety training.

## **About You**

We are looking for someone who is practical, dependable and proud of producing high-quality work.

You will be:

* Hands-on and comfortable working with tools and technical equipment.
* Proactive and willing to take ownership of assigned work.
* Able to follow instructions, technical standards and agreed processes.
* Calm and methodical when diagnosing faults.
* Organised and able to manage changing priorities.
* Comfortable working independently once trained and supported.
* A clear and professional communicator.
* Willing to travel regularly and work flexibly around installations, events and customer requirements.
* Positive, team-focused and willing to support colleagues when needed.
* Motivated to develop your technical skills as Boxbar continues to grow.

## **Skills and Experience**

### **Essential Experience**

* Previous experience working with draught dispense systems, beverage equipment, mechanical installations, plumbing, refrigeration, electrical equipment or a related technical field.
* Practical experience assembling, installing, maintaining or repairing equipment.
* Good mechanical aptitude and confidence using hand and power tools.
* Ability to follow technical instructions, diagrams or schematics.
* Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to communicate professionally with customers, venue teams and colleagues.
* Willingness to travel throughout the UK and occasionally internationally.
* Full UK driving licence.

### **Desirable Experience**

* Experience installing or servicing beer and draught dispense systems.
* Knowledge of keg-to-tap systems, cooling equipment, pumps, gas systems and dispense components.
* Experience working in stadiums, arenas, festivals, hospitality venues or live event environments.
* Basic electrical fault-finding experience.
* Experience completing field-service or installation documentation.
* Relevant technical, electrical, mechanical, plumbing or refrigeration qualifications.
* Cellar management or drinks-quality experience.

Applicants do not need to meet every desirable requirement. Product-specific training and support will be provided.

## **What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role will include:

* Equipment is built and prepared accurately and to the required standard.
* Installations and commissioning work are completed safely and correctly.
* Draught systems deliver consistent drinks quality and reliable performance.
* Faults are diagnosed effectively and repeat service visits are minimised.
* Job reports and technical records are accurate and completed promptly.
* Customers and venue teams receive professional, helpful support.
* Tools, equipment and company vehicles are properly maintained.
* The technician develops increasing technical knowledge and independence over time.
* Positive contribution to workshop standards, teamwork and continuous improvement.

## **Why Join Boxbar?**

* Join a fast-growing technology company changing the way drinks are served.
* Work with innovative, category-defining equipment.
* Support high-profile venues, stadiums, festivals and hospitality partners.
* Develop specialist skills in draught dispense and automated beverage technology.
* Work across varied workshop, installation and live venue environments.
* Receive practical training and support from experienced technical colleagues.
* Build a long-term career within a growing international business.
* Make a visible contribution to the quality and reliability of Boxbar’s customer experience.

We provide expert advice and hands-on system management to help our national and global clients get the most from technology and data. We use innovation wisely to deliver well thought-out digital solutions and software. 

CACI's Consumer & Market Intelligence and Experience & Transformation groups provide data, software and consulting services to improve our clients’ sales and marketing programmes.

We help clients find, retain and grow profitable customers through our understanding of consumer characteristics and behaviour. And we help commercial property developers and retailers plan retail provision in the UK and overseas.

C&MI and E&T Groups help clients shape the vision, define the strategy and deliver a truly integrated customer experience. Our services are based on in-depth understanding of individual consumer behaviour and marketing technology which influence the way consumers buy products and services through a combination of data, technology and consultancy.

This is an exciting opportunity to join Experience and Transformation as a Consulting Solutions Architect. We have a wide-ranging client list, working with some of the biggest and innovative brands in the UK across utilities, gaming, publishing, retail and CPG, leisure, financial services and beyond. We are a rapidly expanding team, working at a fast pace, to develop cutting edge solutions for our clients.

Within this role, you will work closely with Business Analysts, Lead Consultants and technical SMEs to advise on architectures. Integral to the role is working to take the requirements from the BA and to work with the client to perform a number of tasks:

* **Document the As-Is architecture.** Gain a comprehensive understanding of the current architecture, so as to help inform capability gaps but also inform any subsequent architecture changes.
* **Design the To-Be architecture.** Design an end state To-Be architecture that meets the client’s requirements.
* **Phase the To-Be.** Must be able to understand the client’s priorities and take into account dependencies and risks to design the phasing of transition between the As-Is and To-Be.
* **Recommend Components.** Alongside designing both Logical and Physical To-Be diagrams, you will be required to recommend potential specific components that meet the client’s functional requirements whilst also fitting into to the broader business requirements.

This is an integral role within the team. We work closely with our technical partners, especially AWS, to define and shape solutions. You will have an exciting opportunity to take a lead on defining a future state for a range of solutions. Increasingly, much of what we are doing is developing architectures that enable organisations to deploy and operationalise AI models. This is, obviously, an ever-changing market, and you’ll be front and centre of supporting on RnD and performing horizon scanning.

**Key responsibilities**

As referenced in the previous section, you will take lead on a range of technical challenges. However, it is crucial that you are a critical thinker. Much of what you will be doing will be focused on future focused technology, leaning into AI Architecture, and designing solutions that support the delivery of AI models.

Within this role, you will be expected to perform a number of tasks:

* Define and assess technical architectures and solutions
* Define technical and requirements
* Produce high-and-low level technical designs
* Define the tools and practices to be used to monitor and support cloud applications
* Architect end to end solutions that support the ingestion, processing and storage of data, including, potentially, the deployment of ML or AI models
* Architect and make recommendations to rationalise, simplify or optimise architectures
* Make recommendations that may support the following:
  + Digital sovereignty
  + Compute optimisation
  + Cost optimisation

This role will touch on many elements, including data platforms, AI architecture, cloud architecture, MLOPs, integration frameworks, DevOps processes.

You will work closely with the BA and Lead Consultant to make strategic recommendations. With the As-Is architecture you will work with the BA to identify where current capability falls short of what is needed for their marketing and data aspirations and will define and recommend a future architecture, along with clear rationale and explanation as to the decisions that have been made.

You will then be required to design a To-Be architecture that not only addresses the desired capabilities whilst also taking into account the client’s maturity and broader business context. You will then work with the BA and Lead Consultant to phase the architecture to align it with business priorities and other dependencies. To To-Be architecture will then be refined by identifying the scope and requirements for each capability area and recommending suitable vendors.

Alongside this role you may be asked to support in the delivery of implementations conducted by our development team. This would see you working with the development team and Head of Development to design Solutions and also guide them on the development to ensure that they are working to specification.

It is imperative that you feel comfortable in front of technical and non-technical clients:

* Asking questions to understand the As-Is
* Asking questions to gain a full understanding of technical requirements and dependencies
* Presenting your proposed architecture
* Fielding questions from a range of stakeholders, and “defending” your opinion and design

**Skills & experience**

* Understanding of contemporary software engineering, including the selection and application of appropriate technology and patterns
* Confidence working in a team and designing full-stack solutions
* Detailed knowledge of at least one major Cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Confident in-front of clients and technical stakeholders, explaining design decisions
* DevOps and the techniques which enable it, including containerisation, CI/CD and IaC
* Relational and non-relational databases
* Integration methods and transport protocols e.g. REST API, Kafka etc
* Knowledge of Cloud native resources, and their uses and application e.g. Lambdas, Functions, Kubernetes
* Experience of working in agile environments
* Comfortable working with high-level stakeholders, both internally and externally

***Nice to have:***

* Understanding Integration patterns with MarTech and AdTech products
* Digital analytics & tag management – specifically their role in the collect of data and that might be used

**About you**

You understand differing architecture principles, such as monolith, hybrid or microservices, and are able to articulate their benefits and disadvantages

You are inquisitive and future thinking

You are a strong listener with a superb ability to understand a client requirement, whilst also being able to interrogate and ask questions to get into the detail of solutions

Pragmatic – able to make recommendations that balance the need for new capability vs. the upheaval involved in making change and limiting factors

You are confident in understanding and documenting an as-is architecture and articulating its limitations & challenges

You are an analytical thinker who is able to uniquely think about a problem and create To-Be architectures and phasing which meets a client’s nuanced needs

We are ranked as the UK's #1 construction specific software player and our mission is simple; to provide market leading end-to-end software solutions to the construction and construction like industries across the entire build life cycle.

This role is responsible for leading our financial operations, ensuring accurate, timely and insightful financial reporting that supports effective business decision-making across Causeway. Financial Leadership

Team Development

Own the end-to-end monthly close process, ensuring the timely, accurate and complete production of monthly management accounts in line with our reporting timetable.

Lead the preparation and review of the monthly P&L, identifying and investigating significant variances to budget, forecast and prior year, presenting clear, insightful analysis to senior management.

Drive accountability for delivery using close management tools (FloQast) to monitor progress, manage dependencies and proactively address bottlenecks.

Oversee weekly cash flow forecasts, identifying risks and opportunities to support management decision-making.

Challenge the quality and accuracy of financial information, investigating unusual transactions or trends and ensuring corrective action is taken before reporting is finalised.

Continuously review and improve month-end processes, identifying opportunities to streamline activities, strengthen controls and automate manual tasks whilst maintaining governance and accuracy.

Manage the VAT reporting process, ensuring accurate and timely preparation and submission of returns, whilst maintaining full compliance with tax legislation.

Support the financial integration of acquisitions, including accounting, reporting, process alignment and implementation of appropriate financial controls.

Represent Finance in the business, liaising with and providing advice to other functions, interpreting financial results and enhancing reporting to support informed decision-making.

Identify, evaluate and implement opportunities to leverage AI and emerging technologies to streamline finance processes and enhance financial reporting.

### Team Development:

Lead, coach and motivate the team to enable them to perform to their full potential, ensuring objectives are set and regular performance feedback is provided.

Lead by example, fostering a positive working environment, inspiring others and encouraging teamwork, collaboration and the best of Causeway's values.

Maintain a fair and consistent approach, implementing company policies and processes whilst supporting excellent work-life balance.

Qualified Accountant (CIMA, ACCA, ACA or equivalent) with minimum 3-4 years post-qualification experience.

Minimum 3-5 years of hands-on experience in accounting roles, with strong technical accounting skills.

Experience working with complicated legal entity structures and delivering monthly financial reporting.

Strong commercial and business acumen with intermediate to advanced Excel and financial software skills.

Excellent planning and organisational skills, with strong time management, prioritisation and ability to remain calm under pressure.

A high level of accuracy and attention to detail, with ability to synthesise information and recommend solutions.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to explain finances to non-financial colleagues.

Ability to spot trends and anomalies through data and statistical analysis; demonstrable track record of integrity and accountability.

### Desirable:

Experience of acquisition integration and working with multiple financial systems.

Experience in supply chain, financial or construction-related technology sectors.

If you're looking to build an exceptional career with an award-winning company you've come to the right place. We believe everyone at Causeway has a vital role to play in our success. Causeway is fuelled by curiosity and is a place for people who beam with positivity and burn with ambition.

Our team is everything, so we'll take good care of you. In fact, we give well-being the same priority as our other business goals. We're strong advocates of work-life balance, offering hybrid working alongside the opportunity to work from modern, collaborative offices.

We are United.

As part of a team, we're better together.

# Associate Group Leader / Animal Unit Manager

Req ID #:

For 75 years, Charles River employees have worked together to assist in the discovery, development and safe manufacture of new drug therapies. When you join our family, you will have a significant impact on the health and well-being of people across the globe. Whether your background is in life sciences, finance, IT, sales or another area, your skills will play an important role in the work we perform. In return, we’ll help you build a career that you can feel passionate about.

## **The Role**

**Could you be our next compassionate and proven Animal Unit Manager?**

**Ready to lead and manage an animal facility at our site in Portishead?**

You will be responsible for the smooth operation of the animal unit, compliance with UK Home Office regulations, with accountability in resolving day-day leadership tasks, management of several Technical and Husbandry Specialists, while ensuring the highest standards of animal welfare, staff performance, and procedural compliance.

This role requires a hands-on manager with strong organisational skills, sound understanding and hands on experience of working within a regulated animal research environment, and the ability to support a variety of preclinical research studies in a fast-paced Contract Research Organisation.

The role offers the opportunity to play a key part in high-quality research, supporting ethically conducted science and leading a committed animal care team.

## **Main Tasks**

**Operational:**

* Provide operational and people management for a small rodent animal unit.
* Ensure compliance with the Animals (Scientific Procedures) Act 1986 (ASPA) and all Home Office, institutional, and ethical requirements.
* Act as a holder of a Home Office Personal Licence (PIL) and perform licensed procedures as required.
* Oversee animal welfare, husbandry standards, health monitoring, and environmental conditions within the facility.
* Support staff training, performance management, and rota planning.
* Maintain accurate records relating to animal use, staffing, training, and compliance.
* Liaise with scientists, veterinarians, the NACWO, and other Named Persons to support study delivery.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of facility processes, SOPs, and regulatory readiness.
* Support internal and external audits and inspections.
* Keep up to date on latest initiatives concerning animal welfare such as enrichment, handling and procedures.
* Liaise with external sites, facilities to aid continuous improvement in animal welfare.

**People Leader:**

* Effectively manage direct reports on a day-day basis, through meaningful onsite interactions ensuring optimal performance and delivery to assigned client projects.
* Establish strong working relationships across the management community, identifying any potential areas for improvement and/or development and facilitating those opportunities for self and direct reports, where possible.
* Be a positive influence across the group, able to coach, guide and mentor more junior staff and peers as needed to achieve strategic goals as set out by the Senior Leadership Team and Site Director.

## **Qualifications & Experience**

* Degree, HND, or equivalent qualification in a biological or life sciences discipline, or significant equivalent experience in laboratory animal science.
* Demonstrable lab-based industry led experience in the Contract Research Organisation or biotech discovery environment.
* Proven leadership or supervisory experience, overseeing smaller teams on a day-day basis.
* Practical knowledge of standard conditions in animal facilities, including husbandry, biosecurity, environmental controls, and welfare assessment.
* Strong communication skills, able to foster working relationships with peers and reports alike in a professional manner.
* Home Office Personal Licence covering rodents.
* Eligibility and willingness to be appointed as a NACWO under the Animals (Scientific Procedures) Act 1986 (ASPA), subject to Home Office approval.
* Must be able to travel to the Portishead site daily and in an emergency.
* The role requires ability to provide out-of-hours NACWO support and unit work cover.

## **Advantageous, but not essential**

* MSc/PhD within relevant discipline, in applicable field.
* Familiarity with requirements for ex vivo biomarker analysis techniques, assay development and validation.
* Proven track record of project leadership.
* Experience with client communication.
* Home Office Personal Licence covering surgical procedures and hands-on surgical experience in rodents (e.g., aseptic techniques, post-operative care).
* Eligibility and willingness to be appointed as a NTCO and/or NACWO under the Animals (Scientific Procedures) Act 1986 (ASPA), subject to Home Office approval.
* Understanding of use of anaesthetics and analgesics.
* A strong scientific and practical background in data analysis and experimental design.

## **What We Offer You**

Charles River Discovery UK provides a competitive benefits package starting from day one of employment.

**Financial & Retirement:** Highly competitive pension contribution packages, group life assurance, and group income protection.

**Health & Wellness:** Private medical insurance (often extending to family members), private dental care, 24/7 remote GP access, and critical illness cover.

**Work-Life Balance:** Generous parental leave policies, flexible working arrangements depending on business needs, and the option to buy or sell annual leave.

**Additional Perks:** Cycle to work scheme, electric car scheme, paid professional development and training opportunities, and a dedicated employee assistance programme for well-being support.

**About Discovery**  
Discovery from Charles River is industry-proven in the successful development of novel therapies, with over 350 patents and 80 preclinical drug candidates delivered to our sponsors in the past 17 years. Backed by more than 650 scientists, our comprehensive, integrated portfolio employs the latest technology and platforms to provide chemistry, biology, and pharmacology services that support clients from the earliest stages of hit identification all the way through to IND. Our client-focused, collaborative approach creates true partnerships that anticipate challenges, overcome obstacles, and move us forward together on the journey of getting new drugs to market.

**About Charles River**  
Charles River is an early-stage contract research organization (CRO). We have built upon our foundation of laboratory animal medicine and science to develop a diverse portfolio of discovery and safety assessment services, both Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and non-GLP, to support clients from target identification through preclinical development. Charles River also provides a suite of products and services to support our clients’ clinical laboratory testing needs and manufacturing activities. Utilizing this broad portfolio of products and services enables our clients to create a more flexible drug development model, which reduces their costs, enhances their productivity and effectiveness to increase speed to market.

With over 20,000 employees within 110 facilities in over 20 countries around the globe, we are strategically positioned to coordinate worldwide resources and apply multidisciplinary perspectives in resolving our client’s unique challenges. Our client base includes global pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies, government agencies and hospitals and academic institutions around the world.

At Charles River, we are passionate about our role in improving the quality of people’s lives. Our mission, our excellent science and our strong sense of purpose guide us in all that we do, and we approach each day with the knowledge that our work helps to improve the health and well-being of many across the globe. We have proudly supported the development of 86% of the drugs approved by the FDA in 2021.

At Charles River Laboratories, we recognize and recruit all talent. We are a company committed to the principle of diversity and inclusion and work daily in this direction.

## Job description

A Product Manager is responsible for ensuring that a product is of high quality and delivers value. They manage their products through various phases of the product lifecycle, from discovery, development and build, to live running. They balance the goals of the organisation with the needs of end users, and the skills of the product team to scope and build the right products and prioritise how to iterate them over time. Additionally, they may be involved in recruiting and managing personnel within the product team, ensuring they hire the right individuals that are supported, and developed.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Set the product vision, strategy and scope: Define how the product will work to support the organisation or service’s goals and set the scope for what the product will initially do as an MVP, to how it will continually improve or the organisation and end user needs change for a large product or service.
* Stakeholder management: Engage with stakeholders to understand their goals from the service and product, secure their buy-in for the product vision and roadmap, and maintain good working relationships, including managing negotiations over the scope and timelines for product development.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary product teams: Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, which could include user researchers, service designers, business analysis, and software engineers, to shape and build the product.
* User Insight Integration: Work with performance analysts and user researchers to gather customer insights on products for iteration and improvement.
* Develop and maintain the roadmap prioritise the order in which high level features and functionality is built and released, based on what is most valuable to build first, and communicate this through road mapping.  Get buy in for the roadmap from key stakeholders and maintain the roadmap, prioritising and adding enhancements to the product over time to continually improve the product.
* Develop and maintain the backlog: Identify the team tasks (“user stories”) to build the functionality on the roadmap and create a backlog of user stories. Implement the relevant processes such as sprint planning or Kanban, so the team is regularly working through the backlog to build and release features and maintain the backlog to a high-quality standard.
* Build and maintain products to a high-quality standard: Collaborate with colleagues such as designers, user researchers, BAs or engineers to create products that are highly reliable, usable, and accessible for users with accessibility needs, in line with the government service standards.
* Track and improve product performance: Product managers should be able to define how the product will support the organisation’s goal, how that success will be measured (by defining the objectives and key results), and measure progress against these. They should be able to identify improvements and iterations based on feedback to make products more successful.
* Option Evaluation: Collaborate with area leads to assess development options for products or services, including high-level financial implications.
* Community Engagement: Actively participate in the product management community of practice through initiatives, sessions, talks, or activities that help other product managers.
* Support and develop other product managers: this can be through line management, coaching or mentoring more junior product managers or supporting peers.

Candidates who are offered the role will be judged as performing successfully if:

* they are regularly and sustainably delivering product features to the timelines initially negotiated
* if there are stakeholder satisfaction and alignment around the product vision and roadmaps
* if the product is meeting quality standards
* and finally, if they are positively contributing to both their teams and the wider profession community.

## Corporate Associate

The Clarion Corporate team continues to go from strength to strength, and as demand for our expertise grows, we're looking to appoint a Corporate Associate with between two and four years' PQE to join one of the highest-performing corporate teams in the region.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a team recognised for delivering high-quality work across a broad range of corporate matters. Whilst this advert is specifically for an Associate, we're investing in growth across the team and are also recruiting at Senior Associate and Legal Director level as we continue to expand.

If you're looking to build your career in a collaborative team where you'll enjoy early responsibility, high-quality work and genuine opportunities to broaden your experience, we'd love to hear from you.

## The role

You'll work on a varied mix of corporate matters, acting for owner-managed businesses, SMEs and large corporates across a wide range of sectors.

You'll play an active role supporting experienced colleagues on larger transactions whilst also taking responsibility for your own smaller matters as your experience develops.

Your work is likely to include:

* Acting on M&A transactions, including domestic and international transactions.
* Supporting clients on private equity investments, restructures and wider corporate advisory matters.
* Managing your own matters where appropriate and with supervision where needed, as well as supporting partners and/or legal directors on larger, more complex transactions.
