* Building strong relationships with clients and colleagues across the firm, working closely with other specialist teams to deliver seamless advice.

## What we are looking for

We're looking for a Corporate Solicitor with between two and four years' PQE and strong experience acting on corporate transactions. M&A experience is the key requirement for this role, with broader corporate experience able to develop as your career progresses.

You'll also bring:

* Strong technical corporate law knowledge and excellent commercial awareness.
* Experience managing your own workload and contributing effectively to transactions.
* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
* A collaborative approach and enthusiasm for working as part of a high-performing team.
* The ambition to continue developing your expertise across the full spectrum of corporate work.

As the team continues to grow across Associate, Senior Associate and Legal Director levels, there's genuine opportunity to develop your career within a collaborative team that invests in its people and supports long-term progression.

The role is based in Leeds with the flexibility to work from home up to two days per week.

Our Corporate team is one of the most active and successful in the region, advising on a wide range of corporate transactions for an impressive client base. The team's reputation is reflected in its recent achievements. Clarion was crowned Regional Legal Team of the Year at the 2026 Yorkshire Rainmaker Awards for the second year running and is ranked Band 1 by Chambers UK for Corporate/M&A: £5 million and above in Yorkshire, with a number of our lawyers recognised as Leading Individuals. We are seeking a dedicated and motivated Data Capture Technician to operate reality capture equipment, such as 360-degree cameras and other surveying tools, in a variety of environments. The technician will be responsible for capturing comprehensive data of construction sites using different equipment and methodologies that align with algorithmic analysis.

We are looking for someone who is hardworking, responsible, and passionate about fieldwork, with the ability to effectively use technology to collect detailed site information. This is a part-time role, requiring one day of work per week.

**What You'll Do**

* Capture high-quality site data using **360° cameras and other data capture equipment** across active construction sites.
* Document site progress accurately by collecting visual data that supports project tracking and AI-powered construction solutions.
* Follow all site safety procedures and wear the required **Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)** at all times to ensure your safety and the safety of those around you.
* Work closely with the Project Team to meet project requirements and adapt to changing site conditions.
* Handle and maintain company equipment responsibly, ensuring all captured data meets quality standards.
* Follow detailed instructions and complete data capture tasks accurately and consistently.

## Requirements

**What We're Looking For**

* Availability to work **at least one full day per week** during daytime hours.
* Comfortable working on **active construction sites** while following all safety requirements.
* Able to walk **up to 20,000+ steps per day** and perform light physical activities as part of the role.
* Willing to wear the required **Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)** and work in various weather conditions.
* A positive attitude, reliability, and the ability to work well as part of a team.
* Flexible, adaptable, and able to solve problems in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to follow detailed instructions accurately and consistently.
* Comfortable using smartphones, tablets, or other technology to capture and record data.
* Previous fieldwork experience is an advantage.
* A background in **Construction, Surveying, Civil Engineering, Architecture, Site Inspections, Photography, or Reality Capture** is highly preferred.

**Important: Please read before applying.** This is not a standard videography or flexible freelance gig. We are looking for **reliable, punctual, and physically active** individuals to capture critical data on active construction sites.

**The logistics:**

* **Part-Time:** Each construction site requires 1–2 days of capture per week. This is not a full-time role unless you are willing and able to cover multiple sites within your region.

+ Not certified? We will provide the support and resources to help you complete this training before you begin.

* **Safety Gear:** Steel-toed safety boots are mandatory at all times. If you don’t already own a pair, we will reimburse the cost to ensure you have the correct protection.

* **The Environment:** You will be on **active construction sites**. This means wearing full PPE (hard hat, boots, high-vis), walking 20,000+ steps a day, and working outdoors regardless of the weather.
* **Precision Over Creativity:** Your goal is high-quality, systematic data capture following a strict technical brief.

**Team: Strategy, reporting to Impact Consultant**

**About Corndel:**

*Corndel is a unique, multi award-winning UK management and technology training provider that focuses on delivering the highest quality programmes throughout an employee’s career. We partner with some of the UK’s largest and most exciting businesses to help drive organisational and personal performance through transformational learning.*

*Our vision is to shape a world where everyone is empowered to be their professional best. We are one of the fastest growing companies in the UK and provide a great platform for proactive and motivated individuals to take the next exciting step in their career. You will be joining an organisation with a fun, entrepreneurial and supportive environment, providing fulfilling work and an open, informal culture.*

**The role:**

As an Impact Consultant at Corndel, you will work directly with internal and client stakeholders to shape, produce and present compelling evidence of programme impact. You will help clients understand the value Corndel’s programmes are delivering by translating learner and business evidence into clear, credible and commercially useful reports, case studies and presentations.

This is a client-facing impact role. You will lead reporting conversations with clients, help define what evidence will be most meaningful for different audiences, and produce high-quality outputs that support strong client relationships, renewals and wider growth opportunities.

**Responsibilities include:**

* **Lead the production of evidence-led impact reports, case studies and summaries for clients**, tailored to their business goals, programme context and stakeholder audience.
* **Work closely with the wider Business Development team and client stakeholders** to understand what evidence will be most useful, what stories will resonate, and how reports should be positioned for different conversations.
* **Lead client-facing reporting discussions**, present findings, explain outcomes, and consult on identifying the most meaningful and trusted evidence, examples or impact framing.
* **Continuously evolve and enhance impact measurement** by bringing best-in-class ideas and trailing proactive new approaches.
* **Analyse qualitative and quantitative data** from a range of data sources to identify impact insights and clear examples of application of learning.
* **Create high-quality client-facing and internal materials**, including reports, one-pagers, executive summaries, case studies and supporting collateral.
* **Support regular reporting cycles** using agreed templates, frameworks and data sources.
* **Extract strong stories, quotes and proof points** from learner and line manager feedback to support reporting, marketing and commercial conversations.
* **Support internal teams to see the practical value of the evidence** by presenting insights clearly and linking them to business outcomes, stakeholder priorities and programme aims.
* **Support survey and evidence-gathering activity** by helping coordinate reporting requirements, synthesise findings and package outputs for use by internal stakeholders and clients.
* **Maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders** **involved in impact reporting**, ensuring feedback is incorporated and outputs remain useful, credible and audience appropriate.

**About You:**

* You are comfortable working in a client-facing environment and enjoy helping stakeholders understand what evidence means in practice.
* You are a strong writer and communicator who can produce polished materials. You enjoy translating data, stories and evidence into something meaningful for clients and internal stakeholders.
* You are collaborative and confident working with teams and individuals to shape useful outputs and respond to stakeholder needs.
* You care about evidence, clarity and accuracy. You know how to communicate impact in a way that is credible, concise and commercially useful.
* You enjoy producing high-quality deliverables, but you are equally comfortable joining conversations, understanding stakeholder priorities and adapting outputs to different audiences.
* You are motivated by helping clients and colleagues see the real value that Corndel’s programmes are delivering.

**Experience and Skills:**

**Essential:**

* Strong analytical skills and the ability to collect, review and distil qualitative and quantitative data into useful impact insights.
* Client-facing skills, with confidence working alongside colleagues or directly with clients to understand reporting needs, shape outputs and support impact conversations.
* Proficient using Excel, PowerPoint, genAI tools and data/reporting tools to extract client-relevant insights from raw data and create clear, client-ready outputs.
* Effective at collaborative, cross-functional work with Account Managers, Delivery stakeholders and Marketing colleagues.
* Willingness to continuously improve impact measurement approaches and utilise AI in a responsible and proactive manner
* Excellent writing and data storytelling skills, especially for reports, slide decks, case studies and stakeholder summaries.
* Experience producing polished client-facing or stakeholder-facing materials.
* Ability to work accurately with evidence, templates and structured reporting processes.
* Good project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and deadlines.

**Desirable:**

* Experience in Learning and Development, AI and Data Skills training, apprenticeships, programme evaluation, or a related field.
* Familiarity with Power BI or other data analytics tools to analyse data.
* Familiarity with mixed-method evaluation approaches, including surveys, interviews, learner feedback and line manager feedback.
* Familiarity with ROI, business impact, value measurement or evidence frameworks used to assess organisational outcomes.
* Experience working in a fast-moving commercial environment where priorities may shift across clients and stakeholders.

**Why join Corndel?**

* We're committed to having a fully inclusive, welcoming and safe culture and always striving to improve.
* We provide an environment that is truly flexible and supportive, somewhere you will have autonomy over your role.
* We're a leader in our field, with quality and excellence at the heart of what we do.

Today, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty continues to break records across countries, channels, and categories and to scale at pace.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* A strong design portfolio showcasing digital design work (website, emails, social, animated content) across various customer touch points, preferable within luxury/beauty industries
* Competent use of Adobe design suite. Previous experience with collaborative design tools such as Figma preferable
* Strong experience working with animated GIFs and videos, After Effects skills are a big plus
* Understanding and knowledge of online web best practices
* Great sense of design and composition with a strong eye for layout and appreciation of brand guidelines
* Multi-tasker that can respond to changes quickly and prioritise workload effectively
* Maintain accuracy and attention to detail throughout the creative process
* Able to work well using own initiative, as well as collaborate and work as part of a team

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Assist and support the digital design team in creation of visually beautiful and commercial designs across website, email and app
* Design and create evergreen content for weekly email newsletters, following a brief
* Support the Digital Design Team on 360 campaign asset creation for product launches and events using our creative photography (includes but not limited to; Sustain emails, navigation menus, category pages, landing page banners, paid social assets etc.)
* Supporting wider creative teams with resizing our creative imagery
* Support in the creation of Digital Marketing assets e.g. display banners and paid social creative
* Support the team with reactive changes to existing designs
* Ensure all creatives and designs are within brand guidelines
* Ad hoc creative tasks such as creating iconography, graphic montages and animation/gif work etc. to support larger projects
* Conduct research and stay updated on the latest design trends, tools, and technologies
* Help maintain and organize design files and resources
* Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute creative ideas to ongoing projects

**BENEFITS + PERKS**

* Be a part of this values driven, high growth, magical journey with an ultimate vision to empower everyone, everywhere to be the best version of themselves
* We're a hybrid model with flexibility, allowing you to work how best suits you
* 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays) with an additional day to celebrate your birthday
* Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents and carers throughout their parenting and caring journey
* Financial security and planning with our pension and life assurance for all
* Wellness and social benefits including Medicash, Employee Assist Programs and regular social connects with colleagues
* Bring your fury friend to work with you on our allocated dog friendly days and spaces
* And not to forget our generous product discount and gifting!

🌍 A Bit About Us
We’re Doccla, and we’re redefining where and how healthcare is delivered.
Our Virtual Ward and Remote Monitoring Solutions enable hospitals and health systems to care for patients at home. We support patients across the full care journey from early discharge and acute recovery to long-term condition management and proactive care.
We provide everything clinicians need to deliver safe, effective Virtual Care: medical-grade devices, logistics, patient onboarding, EHR integration, and an end-to-end clinical platform built around real-world workflows.
We currently work with over 60% of NHS ICBs and supporting health systems across the including UK, Ireland, France, and the DACH region to reduce hospital pressure, improve outcomes, and create a more resilient model of care.
We’re backed by top European investors, having secured £35m in Series B funding led by Lakestar, with participation from Elaia, General Catalyst, Speedinvest, and Bertelsmann.
🚀 Why Join Us?
This is your chance to join Doccla at a key stage in our growth.
We’re building the category leader in Virtual Care and Remote Patient Monitoring. You’ll be part of a highly entrepreneurial, mission-driven team that combines expertise across clinical, technical, commercial, and operational domains.
We’re solving real problems for patients and health systems and growing fast.
🧑‍⚕️ What You’ll Do as a Senior UX & Service Designer
Our mission is to find patients before they deteriorate, get them enrolled, and keep them engaged for long enough to change their outcome. Everything downstream depends on those three things working.
Ensuring we have a seamless journey that runs across our apps, voice channels, SMS, emails, letters, support scripts, logistics processes and the physical box that arrives at someone's door is what this role is all about. You are the voice of the patient and their advocate in all our design and service decisions.
This is not a role that produces artefacts. It is a role that moves enrollment, onboarding and engagement rates, and is accountable for doing so.
Own the end-to-end experience for proactive care patients and the teams who support them, across every touchpoint:
UX in our apps
Voice experience
Patient-facing communications & content (SMS, email, letter, video, leaflets)
Scripts for Patient Support and Enrolment Specialists
Operational and logistics processes
Physical devices and the contents of the Doccla box
Specifically:
Map the key journeys and improve patient experience. Find the gaps that are limiting enrolment, onboarding and engagement, and close them. Mapping is a tool for finding the solutions, not a deliverable in itself. We’re looking for someone with a bias to action.
Own the numbers. Translate our company and team north star metrics into granular, patient-level tracking. Work with our data team to make sure it's instrumented. Read it. Use it to decide what to work on and to prove whether what you shipped worked.
Design for people who are not like you. Elderly patients, low digital literacy, sensory and cognitive impairment, carers acting on someone else's behalf, people who are unwell and anxious, non-native speakers. This is the core design challenge here and your critical mission.
Run research with patients. Open-ended discovery and focused usability testing. You recruit, you run it, you synthesise, you act on it.
Own content design and tone of voice across patient-facing communications. The words are part of the experience.
Work hand-in-hand with the Enrol and Engage PMs, and with engineers through to implementation. The further you can reach into the build to reduce handoffs, the better.
Collaborate across the business - tech, operations and logistics, clinical, regulatory and commercial. This is not a traditional product design role. As much as the impact will come from improvements beyond our software as from within.
Contribute to the design system. Ensure we have a consistent look and feel across our experiences and enable PMs and engineers to self-serve.
Usability testing. Supporting our regulatory commitments to ensuring usability, including; use-related requirements and risk analysis, formative evaluation through design, summative validation, and supporting the maintenance of the usability engineering file.
✅ What Experience You’ll Bring to the Team
5+ years professional design experience
Startup or scale-up environment
A genuine blend of UX and service design:
UX / product design: wireframes, prototypes and polished production-ready designs, plus the judgement to know which is needed when
Service design: journey mapping and service blueprinting
Research: both open-ended discovery and focused usability testing
Native user of AI in your day-to-day work
Experience designing for non-expert or vulnerable users
Evidence you moved a number. You can name the metric, the change you made, the result, and how you know it was you

Health tech
Regulated industry
Software, hardware and service-based products together

Front-end development skills, or a real appetite to grow into it
🧠 How We Work
We empower everyone at Doccla to take ownership of their work and the company's mission. We act ethically and always put patient safety and outcomes first.
To thrive here, you’ll need a can-do attitude and an action-oriented approach, along with a willingness to learn and grow through open feedback.

Most of our team is London-based and enjoys in-person time at our WeWork HQ 1–3 days per week, where you’ll find great lunch, barista coffee, and a pet-friendly space. Some of our teams are fully remote, depending on the team and responsibilities. This includes our Engineering, Clinical & Patient Support teams.

ElectraLink provides the Data Transfer Service (DTS) to energy market participants, which sends industry data flows through a trusted, central system. ElectraLink also runs the Distribution, Connection and Use of System Agreement (DCUSA) code. ElectraLink also develops APIs, creates energy data insights and contributes to projects for a changing energy system.

The GB energy industry is going through unprecedented change as it moves to a net zero power system by 2030 and a net zero economy by 2050. Data and digitisation is becoming increasingly important to support this transition, with market participants and the regulator looking to make more use of data and make more data available.

The purpose of this role is to support the Industry Engagement Leads by monitoring and analysing industry change with a focus on the industry code and regulatory policy space. This is predominantly an external-facing role including attendance at industry meetings and workgroups. The primary purpose of the role is to identify new not-for-profit services that ElectraLink could deliver; however, the role will also support the expansion of commercial and existing Cost Recovery Services.

At the Ellison Institute of Technology (EIT), we're on a mission to translate scientific discovery into real world impact. We bring together visionary scientists, technologists, policy makers, and entrepreneurs to tackle humanity's greatest challenges in four transformative areas:

* Health, Medical Science & Generative Biology
* Food Security & Sustainable Agriculture
* Climate Change & Managing CO[2]
* Artificial Intelligence & Robotics

At EIT, you'll join a community built on excellence, innovation, tenacity, trust, and collaboration, where bold ideas become real-world breakthroughs. Together, we push boundaries, embrace complexity, and create solutions to scale ideas from lab to society. Explore more at

**Welcome to the Pathogen Program:**

Within this ecosystem, the Pathogen Program exemplifies EIT's dedication to ground-breaking science. It seeks to transform pathogen risk management, detection and response by leveraging Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS)-based metagenomic and pathogen-specific analytical tools. The goal is to power metagenomic devices using long-read sequencing technologies by building a comprehensive database of pathogen information to inform response. The database will comprise >400,00 paired high-quality long read sequences with comprehensive antimicrobial susceptibility profiles. Enabled by Oracle Inc.'s cloud-computing scale and security, the Pathogen Program is advancing toward certified diagnostic tools for deployment in laboratories, hospitals, and public health organisations worldwide.

**Your Role:**

We are looking for a Senior Scientist with expertise in AMR genomics to join the Pathogen Program. This is a predominantly desk-based role working collaboratively across teams within the Pathogen Program to provide expert input on a range of AMR related tasks and topics. You will curate expert rules for interpretation of AMR genotypic data, provide domain-specific analysis and support for genome sequence and AST data generated by the laboratory, provide expert advice for AST testing and investigate putative novel mechanisms of resistance.

This is an excellent opportunity for an enthusiastic individual with a passion for AMR and strong domain-specific knowledge to contribute to an ambitious program of work aiming to revolutionise pathogen diagnostics.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide expert knowledge and input into research and operational activities involving antimicrobials and AMR.
* Develop expert rules for prediction of antimicrobial phenotype from genotypic information.
* Curate catalogues of antimicrobial resistance loci, such as AMRFinderPlus output.
* Contribute to design and quality assurance of antimicrobial susceptibility testing.
* Review paired antimicrobial susceptibility and whole genome sequence data to identify possible anomalies or areas for further investigation.
* Review existing MIC data and identify priorities for further testing or re-testing.
* Interpret and curate data on plasmids and mobile genetic elements from genomic and metagenomic datasets.
* Collaborate with colleagues developing Machine Learning models for AMR prediction from genotype.
* Contribute to research to identify and investigate novel antimicrobial resistance mechanisms identified by Machine Learning models.
* Collaborate with laboratory scientists to produce and evaluate datasets for identification of AMR genes and prediction of antimicrobial susceptibility from metagenomic data.
* Liaise with key internal and external stakeholders involved in EIT's AMR-related activities.
* Opportunity to conduct laboratory research to generate datasets for identification of AMR genes and prediction of antimicrobial susceptibility from metagenomic data.
* Opportunity to contribute to laboratory research investigating putative novel antimicrobial resistance loci.
* Keep up with the latest literature relevant to the field.
* Keep excellent records of work performed.
* Analyse and summarise data, and present data and results at internal or external meetings as required.

* A PhD degree in a relevant scientific discipline (e.g. microbiology, molecular microbiology clinical biology biochemistry).
* over 2 years of post-doctoral research experience.
* Significant research experience in antimicrobial resistance.
* Significant experience working with and interpreting genomic data from bacteria.

# Safeguarding Case Management Group Independent Member

United Kingdom

## Job Description

*The Rugby Football Union (RFU) are seeking a Safeguarding Case Management Group Independent Member to join the The Safeguarding Case Management Group (SCMG) in volunteer capacity.*

**Volunteer Opportunity: Safeguarding Case Management Group Independent Member**

* **Role Type:** Volunteer appointment
* **Anticipated Commitment:** Approximately 8 hours per month, including meeting preparation and urgent case consultations
* **Location:** Primarily virtual (via Microsoft Teams), with occasional attendance at Allianz Stadium
* **Expenses:** Reasonable expenses reimbursed
* **Accountable to:** Chair of the Safeguarding Case Management Group

**Application information:**

* Please submit an anonymised CV (i.e. remove personal details) or an expression of interest.
* Vacancy closing date: **Friday 14th August 2026 17:00PM**
* Shortlisted applicants will be invited to participate in an interview via Microsoft Teams

**Nature and scope:**

Everyone involved in rugby is important and we take our responsibility for their welfare and wellbeing seriously. We want the rugby environment to be a safe and happy one.

The Safeguarding Case Management Group (SCMG) is a cross departmental group charged by the RFU with assessing the risk that individuals may pose to children and adults at risk.

The SCMG consider concerns or referrals presented by the RFU Safeguarding Team and decide on the appropriate outcome following any investigation, including those by police, social care or any other regulatory agency. Information is considered on a paper-based basis and decisions made using a risk-based approach and the balance of probabilities standard.

The SCMG also consider information disclosed on a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) certificate and assess whether the applicant is potentially suitable or is deemed a risk to children or adults at risk.

SCMG members are expected to balance the rights of individuals against the RFU's responsibility to safeguard children and adults at risk, ensuring decisions are fair, proportionate, evidence-based and focused on welfare and safety.

It is essential that the SCMG brings together a wide range of perspectives from both within our sport and outside of it.

We're looking to extend our current complement of expertise and invite applications from individuals who wish to volunteer to use their personal and professional skills, experience and judgement to ensure that Rugby Union in England is safe for children and adults at risk.

**We would be particularly interested to hear from those with a statutory safeguarding or Human Resources backgrounds, or those with experience of safeguarding in sport, including those who have skills in supporting victims of abuse and knowledge of trauma informed practice.**

**Accountabilities:**

* To act with integrity and independence to ensure the decision making process of the SCMG is fair and considered with the primary focus of the safeguarding of children or adults at risk.
* To have an understanding, or a willingness to understand, the RFU Safeguarding Policies, RFU Regulations and the statutory legislation underpinning safeguarding.
* Be guided by the principle that all children and adults at risk have the right to protection from abuse regardless of their age, ability, race, ethnic origin, gender, disability, social status, size, religion or sexual orientation.
* Understanding of safeguarding practice within diverse communities and ability to identify how culture, disability, protected characteristics, vulnerability and lived experience may influence risk and safeguarding outcomes.
* Have an awareness of and commitment to managing information in the strictest confidence.
* To declare any conflict of interest or connection with a particular case.

**Person Specification:**

**Essential:**

* The ability to make proportionate, reasoned and justifiable decisions in safeguarding cases, demonstrating confidence participating in multi-disciplinary decision making.
* Knowledge of safeguarding legislation, statutory guidance and best practice relating to children and adults at risk.
* Ability to access and analyse a variety of evidence in written and other forms
* A professional background in safeguarding or experience of safeguarding in sport

**Desired:**

* Knowledge of the sport of rugby
* Knowledge of human resources and disciplinary proceedings

**Additional Information:**

* This post holder must maintain an appropriate standard of confidentiality.  Any disclosures of confidential information (including personal information kept on computer or other media) made unlawfully outside the proper course of duty will be treated as a serious disciplinary offence.
* Successful applicants will be expected to undertake induction and any safeguarding training identified by the RFU alongside maintenance of their safeguarding knowledge through ongoing development.
* The SCMG meet via Teams on a monthly basis. Meetings are generally held on the second Thursday of each month and take place between 10:00 and 12:30.  In preparation for this meeting, packs are distributed one week prior to meetings with papers and reports that will require thorough reading.
* In addition, particularly when the Safeguarding Team are considering the need for an immediate suspension, SCMG members are asked to respond within 24 hours to requests for views regarding risk.

Further information, or support in your application, please direct this to the RFU Head of Safeguarding - VivienRimmer@RFU.com

## Job Description

Working at the RFU means being part of the ‘bigger picture’ at England Rugby: to be rooted in our purpose, which is to enrich lives, introduce more people to rugby union & develop the sport for future generations. If our purpose resonates with you, and you recognise the value that sport can bring to people’s lives, we’d love to work with you. **Job Title : Regional Fundraising Manager**

* Vacancy closing date: ***7th August at 12:00 noon***

***To help us get to know your unique experience and voice, we kindly ask that you complete your application without the use of AI‐generated content. This ensures we can fairly and accurately understand your skills, perspective, and suitability for the role.***

**The Role:**

The RFU has recently launched Plan 2030: ‘More Than A Game’, which is our strategy to grow rugby across England for the next five years.

Our strategy contains four big goals that support and connect to one another - Play, Perform, Follow and Fund. In ‘Play’ we’re aiming to have an additional 50,000 registered players and have more people playing rugby for longer.

One of the ways we are planning to unlock this growth is through a transformation in how the RFU delivers community rugby by creating seven Regional Growth Partnership Boards tasked with driving participation, building partnerships, and unlocking funding opportunities within their region.

The RFU has launched a new plan focused on the growth of Community Rugby in England. The goal is simple: introduce more people to rugby, and help them keep playing for longer.

To support this, the RFU is creating seven new Regional Growth Partnership Boards. Each board will focus on promoting and growing rugby in its area. Their main responsibilities are to:

* Create new opportunities for people to play rugby in more places
* Build strong regional relationships that help the sport
* Manage RFU funding for local growth projects
* Bring in additional external income to support more opportunities

Each region will have a Regional Fundraising Manager who will lead fundraising and revenue‐generating activity to support these growth plans.

**What the role will do:**

* Lead fundraising across multiple income streams (e.g., public sector grants, trusts, foundations, philanthropy, events, and ESG/commercial funding)
* Work closely with the Regional Partnerships Manager and Regional Board to support the development and delivery of the regional growth plan
* Identify local opportunities and challenges and turn them into successful funding proposals

**Impact / Outcomes:**

* Brings in new external income that directly enables new rugby activity and programmes
* Ensures the region can fund innovative projects that increase participation
* Builds long‐term funding relationships that strengthen community rugby

**The Team:**

Each region will have a small team made up of a Regional Partnerships Manager and a Fundraising Manager, supported by central staff including a Head of Regional Partnerships, a National Fundraising Manager, and Data and Insights Manager.

This team will work closely with a Regional Board made up of independent members, RFU representatives, and people from the community game. Together, they will create and deliver a plan to help more people in the region experience Rugby Union. This is a new team, so you will have the chance to help shape how it works and contribute to building something from the ground up.

Although this role is home‐based, you will spend some time travelling around the region to secure funding opportunities.

**Some key responsibilities include:**

* Work closely with the Regional Partnerships Manager and Regional Board to help develop and deliver the Regional Rugby Promotion & Growth Plan.
* Create and deliver the region’s external funding strategy, securing income from public, private, and charitable sources.
* Lead all fundraising activity, including writing funding applications, running events, and developing early‐stage prospects.
* Bring new, creative ideas to identify and pursue additional fundraising opportunities.
* Track, manage, and report all funding information, from identifying prospects through to receiving and spending funds.
* Build strong relationships and collaborate with colleagues across regions and departments to share learning and best practice.
* Acting as an ambassador for, and promoting the best interests of the RFU, including the promotion of our culture and core values – This Rose Means Everyone: Put The Team First, Shape The Future, Respect Each Other.
* Undertaking other duties as may be required from time to time as are consistent with the responsibilities of the post and the needs of the organisation.

**Qualifications, Skills & Experience:**

*The skills and attributes outlined in this description are not exhaustive and we welcome candidates who can bring different relevant experiences to the role.*

***Essential:***

* Proven experience running successful fundraising programmes across public and private sectors.
* Track record of meeting income targets and KPIs.
* Experience planning and delivering fundraising events.
* Good understanding of how charities work.
* Strong knowledge of best‐practice fundraising at local and regional levels.
* Experience producing accurate financial reports for fundraising activity.
* Experience delivering projects with a range of internal and external partners.
* Confident working with stakeholders at all levels.
* Strong communication and relationship‐building skills, both written and verbal.
* Excellent organisation and time‐management skills, with the ability to handle multiple projects at once.
* Able to work independently and take initiative.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Creative problem‐solver with a positive, proactive attitude.
* Confident using Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
* A passion for the positive impact sport can have in communities.
* Full UK driving licence.
* Committed to embodying the ethos our culture by using our three core values – Put The Team First, Shape The Future, Respect Each Other – to guide your day-to-day decisions, actions and interactions.
* Committed to actively contributing and building an inclusive culture in your role and day to day behaviours.

***Desirable:***

* An understanding of community sport/rugby landscape in England would be an advantage, but is not essential.
* Proficiency with Smartsheet.
* Degree level education or higher desirable, but not essential.
* An effective team member, with sufficient flexibility and willingness to take on roles outside their normal functional responsibility when required.

**Additional Information:**

* During your application, we will ask questions about your identity. This information is considered highly confidential and will not be seen by hiring managers. You can find out more about why we ask these questions here.

## About Us

**About England Rugby**

England Rugby or Rugby Football Union (RFU) is the national governing body for rugby in England. We deliver three core activities, and our purpose is to enrich lives, introduce more people to rugby union and develop the sport for future generations.

**Our core activities are:**

We decide whether entire racks of machines are good enough to enter production. Our team measures and evaluates large-scale Linux systems—from a single rack to data-centre scale. We don’t just run benchmarks; we determine whether a system behaves correctly, and whether it is reliable enough to be trusted.

The work spans designing workloads, building execution systems, and interpreting results. A measurement is only useful if it leads to a decision.

You won’t be confined to a narrow role. Some engineers here focus on infrastructure, others on workloads or analysis—but everyone contributes to understanding system behaviour at scale. You are free to specialise, but as a team we are responsible for leaving no gaps.

* Designing workloads that expose system behaviour
* Building systems to run experiments across large clusters
* Interpreting results and defining what “good enough” looks like

We’re looking for engineers who are comfortable working where the right answer isn’t obvious, and where careful measurement matters more than output volume.

Our engineers typically bring significant practical experience and sound engineering judgement. Depth in one area is valued, but the ability to work across boundaries is equally important.

* Familiarity with **pytest or similar frameworks** for structured test/measurement execution
* Experience analysing **system behaviour under load** (compute, network, or ML workloads)

* Exposure to data analysis, statistics, or interpreting variability in results

* Troubleshoot local area network (LAN) connectivity issues and support internal teams to re-establish remote access to customer environments via SSH, Terminal Services/Remote Desktop Services or Remote Access Controllers.
* Basic troubleshooting of structured cabling links between racks identifying any faults or inconsistencies and liaising with internal or external Cabling teams to repair and re-test.

* Participate, contribute and adhere to strict change control procedures when performing critical moves, adds and changes to any of the supported environments within the Exponential-e Data Centre’s.
* Build a good rapport and show competency with local policies and procedures of our third-party Data Centre providers and Hosts.

* Maintain a professional and disciplined approach when working within Exponential-e Data Centre’s.
* Uphold adherence to ISO 9001, ISO 27001, ISO 20000 & ITIL standards and best practices.
* Manage, process and host access, remote hands and delivery tickets for any visitors or specialist third party technicians requiring access.
* Proactively monitor internal ticketing systems to ensure swift responses within SLA timeframes.
* Ensure Data Centre’s are always kept in a clean and presentable manner.

**Knowledge and experience required:**

* Experience working in a Managed Hosting/Public and or Private Cloud Enterprise Data Centre Environment.
* Proficient in Server, Storage & Network deployment and ongoing break fix support.
* Basic knowledge and understanding of Data Centre M&E Design, Power, Cooling, Redundancy etc
* Demonstrable experience in deploying a variety of industry recognized manufacturers of server, network and storage hardware in complex dedicated environment designs.
* Familiar with IT Hardware Concepts (RAID, SAN, x86 architecture, SCSI, FC, ethernet, iLO)
* Well organized and self-motivated with the ability to work alone and as part of a team.
* Proficient with productivity software including, but not limited to, Microsoft Office and Open Office as well as email client software.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with proficiency with Microsoft office applications.
* Ability to work well under pressure whilst maintaining attention to detail and being able to make informed decisions.
* Passionate, engaged and enthusiastic in delivering a world class service in everything you do.
* Willingness to participate in 24/7 on call Rota to support out of hours incidents.
* Full UK Driving License and personal car is a must for this position.
* Some travel will be made by flight or train and covered by company expenses.

We're hiring a **Payments & Treasury Analyst** to own continuous reconciliation of money movement across the platform, reporting directly to our VP Finance with a dotted line into Operations.

What automation cannot do is own the exceptions daily and apply payments judgement: reading an acquirer statement and spotting a fee that does not match the agreement, or knowing whether a settlement gap is a weekend cycle or a genuine break. * Own the daily acquirer to bank reconciliation across our full acquirer estate
* Stand up and run independent daily monitoring of creator payouts against earnings owed, so no payout moves without reconciliation behind it
* Publish a weekly reconciled percentage per leg to Finance, and keep an exceptions queue that gets worked rather than just logged
* Validate acquirer fees against every merchant services agreement and recover variances
* Map FX exposure across settlement vendors and optimise cash held across our outbound rails
* Sit as Finance's independent second-line voice in our Payments Risk forum
* Turn payments in and payouts out into one standing daily process rather than two separate scrambles

Your Mission

The Construction Site Manager plays a pivotal role in delivering the safe, efficient, and high-quality construction of a 200MW/800MWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) project. The position is focused on overseeing all site-based activities, ensuring works are executed in line with design specifications, programme requirements, and construction best practices, while effectively managing contractors, resources, and interfaces on site.

This role is central to driving construction performance, maintaining strict control of health and safety, quality, and productivity throughout all phases of the build. It supports the successful progression from early works through to commissioning by proactively managing site risks, resolving technical and logistical challenges, and fostering a disciplined, delivery-focused culture that ensures the project is completed on time, within budget, and to the highest construction standards.

## Key Responsibilities

What you’ll be doing

As a Construction Site Manager, you will take full responsibility for the day to day management of site activities, ensuring all works are delivered safely, efficiently, and in line with the project programme and technical requirements. You will work directly with the Project Management Team maintaining clear oversight of progress, productivity, and quality across all construction phases.

This is a broad and varied role with the opportunity to have massive impact. Key responsibilities include:

* Take full responsibility for the day-to-day management of all on-site construction activities;
* Enforce high standards of health, safety, and environmental compliance across site;
* Act as the primary on-site point of contact for project managers, engineers, and stakeholders;
* Liaise and support the Principal Contractor (PC) to coordinate and supervise contractors, subcontractors, and trades across multiple work fronts ensuring alignment with Employers Requirements and contractual commitments;
* Support and oversee PC ensuring that planning and sequence on site works ensure efficient delivery in line with the project programmes;
* Collaborate and support PC for the effective management of site logistics, including access, materials, plant, and resource allocation;
* Oversee civil, electrical, and mechanical installations, ensuring alignment with design specifications and contractual obligations;
* Monitor progress against key milestones and take proactive action to mitigate delays;
* Lead site briefings, watching briefs (as required), inspections, and audits, addressing risks and non-conformances promptly;
* Ensure quality control processes are followed, including inspections, testing, and documentation;
* Facilitate clear communication between all parties to resolve technical and logistical issues;
* Track and report on site performance, productivity, and programme status;
* Drive a culture of accountability, teamwork, and high performance on site;
* Ensure the project is delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the highest construction standards

Key Accountabilities

**QHSE Leadership**

* Lead a “safety-first” culture and verify compliance with CDM arrangements, site rules, RAMS, Safe Systems of Work (SSOW) and Permits-to-Work (PTW).
* Oversee high-risk activities: lifting plans (containers/transformers), excavations/temporary works, electrical isolations, switching coordination, hot works, working at height, confined spaces (this is not an exhaustive list).
* Ensure robust controls for BESS hazards: thermal runaway mitigation, separation/segregation, ventilation and gas detection, fire strategy implementation, emergency response plan and drills, and site access protocols for containers.
* Maintain environmental and community controls: noise/dust, traffic management, waste, spill prevention, drainage protection and planning condition compliance.

**Construction Oversight on both BOP and BESS**

* Verify work is delivered to IFC drawings/specs, ITPs, hold points, and OEM installation requirements.
* Focus on critical quality risks:
  + BOP: civils tolerances, duct banks, cable pulls/bending radii, gland/termination workmanship, earthing continuity/resistance, P&C wiring/labels, enclosure ingress protection.
  + BESS: container placement/tolerances, HVAC commissioning prerequisites, fire system installation integrity, comms/SCADA networks, auxiliary power reliability, OEM checklists completion.
* Raise/track NCRs and drive corrective actions to reduce rework and protect schedule.

**Programme, Progress & Interface Control**

* Track daily progress against schedule and 2 week lookaheads across both BESS and BOP workflows
* Identify constraints early and propose mitigations.
* Attend coordination meetings and ensure decisions/actions are closed out with clear owners and dates.

**Contractor Governance and Change Control**

* Act as Fields focal point for site decisions within delegated authority; escalate risks and commercial impacts promptly.
* Manage interfaces between EPC, BESS OEM, BOP contractors, TO, commissioning teams, and third parties (telecoms, security, metering).
* Support change control by spotting scope deviations and ensuring approvals are documented and implemented correctly.

### **Commissioning, energisation & handover readiness**

* Support pre-commissioning and commissioning activities: walkdowns, test witnessing, SAT coordination, and system integration checks (BESS–EMS–SCADA–P&C).
* Coordinate energisation readiness packs: switching plans, competencies, documentation completeness, emergency arrangements, and contingency plans.
* Drive handover deliverables: punch list closure evidence, test packs, as-builts, O&M manuals, spares/warranties, training records, and completion dossiers for Operations.

* Maintain a tidy, audit-ready site; host visits and manage close-out of findings.
* Support landowner/community engagement and ensure issues are logged, responded to, and closed out.
* Ensure compliance with planning conditions and local constraints.

**Key Deliverables**

* Daily site diary and weekly progress/QHSE report (with photos).
* Integrated BESS/BOP interface log, risk register inputs, and constraints tracker
* Punch list / snag register (prioritised and evidenced close-out)
* Commissioning & energisation readiness (“go/no-go”) packs
* Handover dossier support: test results, certificates, as-builts, training and spares lists

**Essential:**

* Proven site-based delivery experience on UK energy infrastructure with exposure to BESS and/or HV BOP works.
* Strong understanding of construction sequencing across civils + electrical + controls/SCADA.

## Company Description

Genomics England is a global leader in enabling genomic medicine and research, focused on creating a world where everyone benefits from genomic healthcare. Building on the 100,000 Genomes Project, we support the NHS’s world-first national whole genome sequencing service and run the growing National Genomic Research Library, alongside delivering numerous major genomics initiatives. By connecting research and clinical care at national scale, we enable immediate healthcare benefits and advances for the future.

Our mission is to provide the evidence and digital systems so that by 2035 genomics could play a role in up to half of all healthcare interactions, whilst securing the UK’s position as the best place to discover, prove and benefit from genomic innovations.

We are accelerating our impact and working with patients, doctors, scientists, government and industry to improve genomic testing, and help researchers access the health data and technology they need to make new medical discoveries and create more effective, targeted medicines for everybody.

Behind the Healthcare and Research outcomes, Genomics England delivers through designing, developing and operating complex healthcare software systems.

We're on the cusp of big changes with the real prospect of genomics becoming the fabric of everyday healthcare through the lifetime – from birth to old age.

## Job Description

We are hiring a Head of Staffing & Workforce Planning to lead the Staffing & Workforce Planning function, overseeing workforce planning, staffing governance and resourcing operations across Genomics England.

Working closely with the Director of Strategic Talent & Workforce Planning, People colleagues and senior leaders, you will ensure workforce plans are robust, data-driven and aligned with organisational priorities, whilst providing a trusted single source of workforce insight, enabling informed decisions on role creation, prioritisation, contractor use and workforce deployment.

Using data, governance and continuous improvement, you will identify workforce risks and capability gaps, strengthen planning approaches, and help build a sustainable workforce for the future.

**Everyday responsibilities include:**

* Own and maintain the organisational Workforce Plan as the single source of truth for agreed roles, staffing status, position IDs, approvals and key workforce movements.
* Manage day-to-day staffing governance processes, ensuring role creation, role changes, transfers and resourcing decisions are recorded accurately, consistently and transparently.
* Work with Service Owners, Product Managers, Chapter Leads, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition and People colleagues to understand workforce requirements and identify the most appropriate resourcing options.
* Support workforce planning activity, including capacity planning, workforce optimisation, productivity analysis and role prioritisation across teams and squads.
* Work with Chapter Leads and Learning & Development to map skills and capabilities, identify skills gaps and support opportunities for internal mobility, career growth and effective deployment.
* Track contractor and contingent labour usage, including end dates, extensions, approval workflows and related workforce risks, escalating issues where appropriate.
* Produce clear, accurate and actionable MI to support leadership reviews, workforce planning discussions, staffing decisions and contractor oversight.
* Monitor workforce data quality, investigate discrepancies and implement improvements to strengthen accuracy, usability and confidence in workforce reporting.
* Review resourcing-related procurement and approval requests, including relevant JIRA tickets, ensuring actions are progressed and governance requirements are met.
* Contribute to People projects and continuous improvement initiatives, identifying opportunities to simplify processes, improve workforce visibility and enhance stakeholder experience.

**Skills & experience for success:**

* Extensive experience leading workforce planning, staffing or resource management activities in a complex organisation.
* Strong analytical skills, with experience using workforce data and tools such as Power BI, Tableau or Power Query to support planning and decision-making.
* Experience developing workforce plans, including capacity planning, forecasting, prioritisation and resource allocation.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and build effective relationships with senior leaders (including executive level) and cross-functional teams.
* Excellent communication skills, with experience preparing and presenting reports, business cases and recommendations to support strategic decisions.
* Strong project and operational management skills, with the ability to lead multiple priorities, improve processes and deliver organisational outcomes.
* A collaborative and continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to identify workforce risks, capability gaps and opportunities to strengthen workforce planning and governance.

**Desirable skills:**

* Commercially astute, with experience managing budgets, assessing value for money and making resourcing decisions that balance quality, cost and organisational need.
* Experience working across different organisational environments, ideally including public and private sector settings, with the adaptability to operate in start-up, scale-up or established organisations.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity, identifying skills and capability gaps, improving processes and using third-party or contingent resources to support a flexible workforce model.

**What We Do**

At Goldman Sachs, quantitative strategists are the cutting edge of our businesses, solving real-world problems through a variety of analytical methods. Working in close collaboration with traders and sales, strats' invaluable quantitative perspectives on complex financial and technical challenges power our business decisions.

Within our Global Banking & Markets business, **Commodities Strats** sit on trading floors and provide value for both internal & external clients through cutting-edge models, predictive analytics, and high-quality trading tools. We are a dynamic, entrepreneurial team with a passion for the markets, with individuals who thrive in fast-paced, changing environments and are energized by a bustling trading floor.

While all trading desks at GS require strong quantitative skills, the **Commodities** desk is unique in that its products are at the centre of a changing world, where the environment, broader scientific R&D, geopolitics and global supply lines impact markets daily, and the pace of progress is rapid. We're looking for candidates with strong quantitative, programming, and communication skills with a keen interest applying those skills in the financial markets. As a desk strat on our Commodities trading desk, you’ll have the opportunity to apply your quantitative acumen towards solving complex problems and creating innovative solutions for our clients.

Your work will directly impact the firm's bottom line. Whether it’s developing automatic pricing algorithms to help our trading desks make better decisions or building a pricing model product that will help clients hedge risk, you'll create an immediate commercial impact for the firm.

* Develop and maintain derivatives pricing models across multiple sub-asset classes, e.g. Gas & Power, Oil Products, Metals.

* Building algorithms and models for automated pricing and quoting of derivatives.

* Expand the scope of our automated pricing capabilities to new underliers/payoffs, solving idiosyncratic challenges along the way.

* Contribute to physical commodities and structured transactions across the business.

* Be involved with all stages of the software development life cycle with a range of technologies and collaborate closely with engineering teams who support the underlying infrastructure and frameworks.

* Excellent academic record in a relevant quantitative field such as Physics, Mathematics, Engineering or Computer Science.

* Experience in object-oriented programming with a language such as C++, Java or Python.

* Experience in finance or a cutting-edge technology company.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

# Senior Software Engineer - k6 Core | United Kingdom | Remote

United Kingdom (Remote)

Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

## Senior Software Engineer - k6 Core

#### **The Opportunity:**

At k6, we build reliability and performance testing tools for developers and QA engineers.

Grafana k6 is an open-source project focused on making performance testing practical, approachable, and useful in real-world engineering workflows. We care deeply about developer experience, correctness, and scalability. k6 is part of the Grafana ecosystem and is used by engineers to test and understand systems under real load.

#### **What You’ll Be Doing:**

You will join a team of engineers responsible for building and maintaining k6, a performance testing tool written in Go. The team also maintains the open-source project, which means working directly on the product, the codebase, and with the community using it.

In this role, you will work on features and improvements across the k6 codebase, from initial idea through implementation and delivery. Much of the work involves problems that are not fully specified up front and require understanding the context, evaluating trade-offs, and choosing a reasonable technical approach.

You will work with a high degree of independence while collaborating closely with other engineers on design, implementation, and code reviews. You are expected to deliver production-quality code, maintain existing functionality, and help keep the system reliable and maintainable over time.

Some work may involve the k6 cloud offering, which builds on top of k6 to run distributed tests across data centers worldwide. This includes Go services that support distributed execution and require careful attention to performance, correctness, and failure modes.

Because the team is small, your work will have a direct and visible impact on the product and its users. You will work alongside experienced engineers in an environment that values clarity, pragmatism, and sound engineering judgment.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

#### **What Makes You a Great Fit:**

We start with problems, not prescriptions. Engineers are expected to understand the constraints, propose a pragmatic design, and carry the work through to delivery. We move deliberately and release on a regular cadence of roughly every six weeks. Between releases, we focus on small, safe, incremental changes.

Work is asynchronous by default, with decisions captured in pull requests and short design notes. Meetings are used for alignment rather than status updates. Code reviews focus on correctness, long-term maintainability, and user impact. When trade-offs are required, we aim to make them explicit and reversible. The team owns the product end to end, including architecture, releases, user-facing behavior, and the health of the open-source project.

We’re looking for an experienced engineer with strong programming skills and a track record of working on non-trivial systems.

You should have:

* Strong experience building production software in Go, or another language with good support for concurrency and parallelism
* Experience working on larger or long-lived codebases
* The ability to work independently on scoped problems and deliver them to completion
* Clear technical communication skills, especially in code reviews and design discussions
* A good understanding of internet protocols such as HTTP, gRPC, and WebSockets, with some familiarity with lower-level networking concepts
* Experience with modern development practices, including testing, code review, and iterative development

#### **Bonus Points For:**

You do not need experience with everything listed below. These are areas where familiarity is useful for the role, and the more you bring, the easier the ramp-up will be:

* Contributing to or maintaining open-source projects
* Prior experience using k6 in production, or contributing to the k6 project or ecosystem
* Performance, reliability, or network testing and optimization
* Distributed systems or cloud-based services
* JavaScript and/or TypeScript
* Backend systems for web or mobile applications
* Tools and platforms such as Docker, AWS, microservices architectures, and observability tools like Grafana or APM systems

**Compensation & Rewards:**

In the United Kingdom, the Base compensation range for this role is GBP 91,755  -  GBP 110,106.  Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*\*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.*

**Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:**

* **100% Remote, Global Culture -**As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* **Scaling Organization** – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* **Transparent Communication** – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* **Innovation-Driven** – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
* **Open Source Roots** – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
* **Empowered Teams** – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
* **Career Growth Pathways** – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
* **Approachable Leadership** – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
* **Passionate People** – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* **In-Person onboarding** - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* **Balance is Key** - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *\*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.*

**Equal Opportunity Employer:** *Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*

|  | The Oncology Research department is seeking an immuno-oncologist to join the Cancer Disease Biology team. In this role, you will develop a suite of in vitro immunology and cancer assays and build biologically rich datasets to support several drug programmes. You will establish advanced disease models, including adult stem cell–derived organoids, that recapitulate key aspects of drug target, immune and tumour biology. This will include optimising model growth, immune co-culture conditions and phenotyping approaches to better represent patient tumours across relevant biomarkers and disease subtypes.    A major focus will be modelling key barriers to therapeutic response, including the cancer cell–intrinsic states that fuel tumour progression, relapse and metastasis, as well as features of the tumour microenvironment (TME), recreated through immune and stromal cell co-culture. You will use these models to test the efficacy of ImmTAC molecules, Immunocore’s TCR-based bispecific therapeutics, and assess how effectively they overcome disease-relevant challenges.    Through this work, you will help to dissect ImmTAC mechanism of action, identify biological factors that influence response and resistance in pre-clinical models, explore combination therapy strategies and test new drug design concepts. Your work will generate novel insights into disease biology and TCR therapeutics, directly supporting Oncology Research and drug development. You will also be supported to present and publish your findings internally and externally. This role offers the opportunity to work at the interface of disease biology, pharmacology and TCR-based therapeutics, contributing directly to drug discovery strategy.    You will be a naturally inquisitive problem-solver who can integrate cancer biology, immunology and disease modelling to design robust experiments and interpret complex datasets. Comfortable learning new techniques and moving between research areas, you will adapt readily to the changing needs of varied and challenging projects. You will be a strong team player who can also work independently, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and the confidence to navigate ambiguity and solve complex problems creatively.    KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  • Develop a detailed understanding of drug targets and cancer indications of strategic interest to Immunocore, in collaboration with colleagues.  • Generate patient-relevant in vitro disease models, including adult stem cell–derived organoids, that represent drug target biology, cancer cell states and relevant features of the tumour microenvironment.  • Characterise and phenotype these models using relevant molecular, cellular and functional readouts to assess how faithfully they reflect patient tumours, biomarkers and disease subtypes.  • Test ImmTAC efficacy in these models and assess their ability to overcome barriers to therapeutic response, including cancer cell–intrinsic states associated with progression, relapse and metastasis.  • Investigate how immune and stromal cell composition, as well as standard-of-care therapeutics, affect target expression, tumour biology and ImmTAC efficacy/mechanism of action.  • Explore rational combination therapy opportunities based on disease biology and mechanism of action.  • Contribute proactively to project and programme team meetings by generating, interpreting and communicating data packages that address key scientific questions and inform go/no-go decisions.  • Help establish and support internal and external collaborations, including with key opinion leaders, to accelerate oncology research and pharmacology studies.  • Keep up to date with the scientific literature and latest developments in immuno-oncology and disease modelling.  • Contribute to peer-reviewed publications and patents.  • Present scientific findings at internal and external conferences.  • Provide technical training and mentorship to support fellow team members.    PROFILE SPECIFICATION    Experience & knowledge    Essential  • Strong understanding of immunology and cancer cell biology, and their application to disease modelling.  • Demonstrable experience generating, culturing and phenotyping cancer models, including 2D and 3D in vitro systems such as organoids or spheroids, and/or ex vivo systems such as tissue fragments, tissue slices or organ-on-chip models.  • Pharmacology experience testing the effects of therapeutic molecules on tumour biology, immune cell activation and cancer cell killing using patient-relevant disease models.  • Experience with immunoassay techniques, including T cell activation and killing assays, proliferation assays and cytokine measurements.  • Experience characterising disease models using approaches such as sequencing, microscopy and/or histology to assess how well they represent patient disease and disease subtypes.  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.    Desirable  • Experience modelling complex tumour microenvironments through immune and/or stromal cell co-culture.  • Experience with omics technologies, such as bulk or single-cell genomics/transcriptomics, proteomics and/or mass spectrometry.  • Experience with, or strong working knowledge of, genetic modification approaches in cancer and/or primary human immune cells, such as CRISPR, lentiviral transduction or si/shRNA.  • Experience with advanced microscopy techniques, such as confocal, single-molecule, super-resolution, TIRF, live-cell and fixed-cell imaging.  • Bioinformatics or data analysis skills, for example using R or Python.  • High-throughput screening and automation experience.  • Pharma or biotech laboratory experience.    We welcome applications from candidates who bring strong expertise in some, but not necessarily all, of these areas and who are motivated to develop new capabilities.    KEY BEHAVIOURAL ATTRIBUTES    • Openness and honesty  Readily offering information pertaining to work in hand whether positive or negative.  • Taking responsibility  Being prepared to accept full responsibility for tasks entrusted to them; seeing tasks through to completion and dealing with the consequences of failure or success.  • Flexibility  Being flexible to new ideas and approaches; changes of plans, objectives and/or priorities. Handling disjointed tasks effectively.  • Team spirit  Being able to work productively with others to achieve tasks. Showing consideration for the needs and feelings of others.    SPECIFIC BEHAVIOURAL ATTRIBUTES    • Attention to Communication: Ensuring information and work is passed on correctly and in a timely way to those who depend on it.  • Written & Oral Communication: Writing and speaking clearly to share thoughts and information concisely and appropriately.  • Diagnostic Information Gathering: Identifying the information required to clarify a situation, asking questions when required.  • Results Orientated: Focusing on desired results, seeking help and support to overcome obstacles in a timely manner.  • Thoroughness: Ensuring work and information provided is complete, carefully checking and seeking additional support to help achieve this if needed.  • Managing Self Performance: Works to specific and measurable goals, seeking support and advice when dealing with unfamiliar or new issues.  • Analytical Thinking: Tackling day –to-day problems using a logical and systematic approach, identifying discrepancies and inconsistencies.    Education & qualifications  • A PhD in immunology, cancer biology or a related discipline, with experience in cancer disease modelling and/or immuno-oncology.  • 3+ years’ experience of post-doctoral research in an academic or industrial setting |
|  | Immunocore (NASDAQ: IMCR) is a pioneering, commercial-stage T cell receptor biotechnology company whose purpose is to develop and commercialize a new generation of transformative medicines which address unmet patient needs in oncology, infectious diseases and autoimmune disease. Our leaders in R&D are internationally recognised as some of the biotech industry’s most successful drug developers. We are creating not just an environment where great minds can interact but an innovation powerhouse answering the big questions.    Focused on delivering first-in-class biological therapies to patients, we have developed a highly innovative soluble TCR platform. Our ImmTAX molecules underpin a new generation of precision engineered drugs that harness the immune system to treat a broad spectrum of diseases with high unmet medical need, including oncology, infectious diseases and autoimmune diseases.    At Immunocore, we recognize that our employees are our greatest asset. We value the unique contributions each person brings to our team.
