Engineering Manager - Job Description   
Reports to Operations Manager   
Direct reports 4 M&E Shift Engineers   
Site-based role 

Purpose   
To lead the engineering function, maintain critical infrastructure resilience, manage engineering risks, and provide technical leadership to the shift engineering team.

Role Overview   
Reporting to the Operations Manager, the Engineering Manager is responsible for the safe, reliable and effective   
operation of the data centre critical mechanical and electrical infrastructure. The Engineering Manager will provide leadership and technical oversight to a team of four M&E Shift Engineers responsible for the 24/7 operation and monitoring of the data centre. The role is responsible for ensuring that critical infrastructure is operated and maintained to the required standards, engineering risks are effectively managed, incidents are appropriately responded to and investigated, and the engineering team has the competence, procedures and support required to perform their duties safely and effectively. The Engineering Manager will work closely with the Operations Manager, customers, contractors, equipment manufacturers and other internal stakeholders to maintain site availability, improve operational resilience and support the continued development of the data centre.

Key Responsibilities   
Engineering Team Leadership and Management   
• Lead, manage and develop a team of four M&E Shift Engineers providing 24/7 operational coverage of the   
data centre.   
• Provide clear leadership, direction and technical support to the shift engineering team.   
• Conduct regular one-to-one meetings, performance reviews and development discussions.   
• Establish clear objectives and performance expectations for the engineering team.   
• Identify training and competency requirements and develop appropriate training and development plans.   
• Maintain an engineering competency framework and ensure engineers are appropriately trained, assessed   
and authorised for the activities they undertake.   
• Promote a culture of accountability, ownership, continuous improvement and high engineering standards.   
• Monitor shift performance, standards of communication, record keeping and completion of operational   
activities.   
• Ensure effective communication and handover between shifts and between the shift engineering team and   
site management.   
• Support recruitment, onboarding and development of engineering personnel when required.

Critical Infrastructure Operations   
• Oversee the safe and reliable operation of the data centre critical mechanical and electrical infrastructure,   
including HV and LV electrical distribution systems, UPS systems, standby generators, cooling systems,   
BMS, fire detection and suppression systems and associated building services.   
• Ensure critical infrastructure is operated in accordance with approved procedures, manufacturer   
recommendations, statutory requirements and industry best practice.   
• Monitor the condition, performance, capacity and resilience of critical infrastructure and identify emerging   
risks or potential points of failure.   
• Ensure equipment defects, alarms and abnormal operating conditions are appropriately investigated,   
escalated and managed.   
• Maintain appropriate operational resilience and ensure risks to data centre availability are identified,   
communicated and mitigated.   
• Review engineering alarms, trends and operational data to identify recurring issues and opportunities to   
improve system performance and reliability.   
• Support capacity planning, infrastructure upgrades, customer installations and expansion projects.   
Maintenance Management   
• Ensure all critical infrastructure is maintained in accordance with manufacturer recommendations, statutory   
requirements, contractual obligations and recognised engineering standards.   
• Plan and coordinate maintenance activities to minimise operational risk and disruption to customers.   
• Review maintenance reports and ensure defects, observations and recommendations are appropriately   
assessed, prioritised and tracked through to completion.   
• Monitor outstanding defects, remedial works and equipment reliability issues and escalate risks where   
appropriate.   
• Ensure maintenance activities are subject to appropriate planning, risk assessment, change control and   
technical review.   
• Analyse equipment failures and maintenance performance to identify trends and opportunities to improve   
reliability.

Incident Management and Operational Escalation   
• Act as the first management escalation point for engineering incidents and significant operational issues.   
• Participate in the site management escalation and on-call arrangements as required.   
• 24/7 availability.   
• Provide technical leadership and support to the shift engineering team during incidents and abnormal   
operating conditions.   
• Ensure incidents are appropriately managed, escalated, communicated and documented.   
• Lead or support engineering incident investigations, root cause analysis and the development of corrective   
and preventative actions.   
• Ensure lessons learned from incidents, failures and near misses are communicated and incorporated into   
procedures, training and operational practices.   
• Monitor corrective and preventative actions through to completion.   
• Support the Operations Manager with customer communications, incident reports and technical   
investigations.

Customer Engagement and Technical Representation   
• Act as a senior technical and operational representative of the data centre when engaging with key   
customers.   
• Attend regular operational, service review and engineering meetings with key customers, including the data   
centre largest and most critical customers.   
• Build and maintain strong working relationships with customer engineering, operations and management   
teams.   
• Provide clear and accurate updates on site engineering performance, infrastructure reliability, maintenance   
activities, operational risks and improvement initiatives.   
• Present and explain technical information, engineering risks and complex infrastructure issues clearly to both   
technical and non-technical customer stakeholders.   
• Participate in customer meetings following incidents and significant operational events, supporting the   
Operations Manager with technical explanations, investigation findings, root cause analysis and corrective   
and preventative actions.   
• Respond to customer technical queries and requests for engineering information, ensuring responses are   
accurate, timely and appropriately reviewed.   
• Support customer audits, site inspections, resilience reviews, due diligence activities and technical   
assessments.

• Manage customer expectations regarding engineering activities, maintenance, defects, infrastructure risks   
and project delivery.   
• Develop credibility and trust with key customers through strong technical knowledge, effective communication   
and consistent delivery.

Electrical Safety and Authorised Person Responsibilities   
• Support the effective implementation and management of the site Electrical Safety Rules.   
• Act as a High Voltage Authorised Person (HVAP), subject to appropriate competency assessment and   
appointment.   
• Undertake or oversee HV switching activities in accordance with the site Electrical Safety Rules and approved   
switching procedures.   
• Support the management, appointment and competency assessment of Authorised Persons and Competent   
Persons where applicable.   
• Ensure electrical activities are appropriately planned, risk assessed and controlled.   
• Promote high standards of electrical safety across the site.   
Contractor and Vendor Management   
• Monitor contractor performance against agreed service levels, maintenance requirements and site standards.   
• Ensure contractors working on critical infrastructure are appropriately competent, inducted, supervised and   
managed.   
• Challenge suppliers and service providers where performance, response times or quality of service do not   
meet the required standards.   
• Coordinate planned maintenance, repairs, emergency call-outs and remedial works.   
• Develop effective working relationships with key equipment manufacturers and specialist service providers.   
• Support procurement and commercial teams with the evaluation and management of engineering service   
contracts.

Health, Safety and Compliance   
• Ensure engineering activities are undertaken safely and in accordance with applicable legislation, company   
policies and site procedures.   
• Promote a strong safety culture within the engineering team.   
• Ensure appropriate risk assessments, method statements, permits and safe systems of work are in place for   
engineering activities.   
• Participate in safety inspections, audits, incident investigations and compliance reviews.   
• Ensure statutory inspections, testing and maintenance activities are completed within required timescales.   
• Identify engineering and operational risks and ensure appropriate mitigation measures are implemented.   
• Support compliance with applicable environmental, energy and sustainability requirements.   
Projects and Change Management   
• Provide operational and technical input into infrastructure upgrades, customer installations and capital   
projects.   
• Ensure new and modified infrastructure is appropriately documented and incorporated into maintenance   
programmes, procedures and training.   
• Ensure engineering changes are subject to appropriate technical review, risk assessment, approval and   
change management.

Qualifications and Experience   
Essential   
• Recognised technical qualification in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Building Services   
Engineering or a related engineering discipline.   
• Significant experience working within a critical infrastructure environment such as data centres,   
telecommunications, healthcare, financial services, utilities or other 24/7 operational facilities.   
• Strong understanding of critical mechanical and electrical infrastructure.   
• Experience managing or supervising engineering teams.   
• Experience managing planned and reactive maintenance activities.   
• Experience responding to and managing engineering incidents and equipment failures.   
• Experience managing contractors, maintenance providers and specialist engineering vendors.   
• Experience managing senior customer relationships and participating in technical or operational meetings   
with key customers.   
• Strong understanding of safe systems of work, risk management and engineering operational procedures.   
• Excellent communication, leadership, organisational and problem-solving skills.   
• Ability to remain calm and make effective decisions during incidents and other high-pressure operational   
situations.

Desirable   
• Previous engineering management experience within a data centre environment.   
• High Voltage Authorised Person experience or the ability to achieve HVAP authorisation following appropriate   
training and competency assessment.   
• Recognised health and safety qualification such as IOSH Managing Safely or NEBOSH.   
• Experience implementing or managing Electrical Safety Rules.   
• Experience with critical infrastructure maintenance management systems and Computerised Maintenance   
Management Systems (CMMS).   
• Experience with BMS, EPMS and other critical infrastructure monitoring platforms.   
• Knowledge of data centre standards and frameworks such as Uptime Institute, EN 50600 or ISO   
management systems.   
• Experience supporting infrastructure upgrades, commissioning and integrated systems testing.   
Skills and Competencies   
• Strong leadership and people management skills.   
• Strong technical understanding of mechanical and electrical critical infrastructure.   
• Effective decision-making and problem-solving abilities.   
• Ability to lead engineering teams during incidents and high-pressure situations.   
• Strong organisational and planning skills.   
• Effective contractor and supplier management.   
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.   
• Ability to communicate technical issues clearly to operational management, customers and non-technical   
stakeholders.   
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify trends, risks and opportunities for improvement.   
• Ability to prioritise competing operational requirements and manage multiple workstreams.   
• High standards of attention to detail and engineering governance.   
• Commitment to safety, reliability, operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Working Arrangements   
The role is primarily site-based due to the operational nature of the position and the requirement to provide   
leadership and technical oversight of the data centre engineering team. The Engineering Manager will be expected to provide reasonable flexibility to support significant engineering activities, planned works and operational incidents outside normal working hours. Participation in the site management escalation or on-call arrangements may be required.

This is a senior role for someone who enjoys both strategy and execution, and who wants to build lasting marketing capability rather than simply manage a campaign calendar.

* **Partner and channel marketing:** Strengthen DisplayNote’s proposition to OEMs, distributors, resellers, integrators and MSPs through co-marketing, launch support, partner enablement and joint demand generation.

* **Content and communications:** Oversee content, thought leadership, PR, executive communications, website, events and digital channels, ensuring consistent messaging and effective reuse across the buyer journey.

* **Commercial alignment:** Work closely with Sales, Product and Customer Success to improve proposition clarity, product launches, pipeline generation, customer engagement and market feedback loops.

* **Team and resource leadership:** Lead and develop the Marketing Manager, manage agencies and external partners, and recommend the future skills, structure, technology and investment needed to scale the function.

* **Continuous improvement:** Use AI and modern marketing practices responsibly to improve the speed, quality and efficiency of research, planning, execution and analysis.

**40% — Marketing delivery**

Owning and improving campaigns, content, product launches, website activity, events, email marketing, social media, partner marketing and digital channels during maternity cover.

**35% — Strategy and functional development**

Developing marketing plans, improving positioning, building reporting, refining processes, managing external resources and designing the future marketing function.

**25% — Commercial partnership**

Working closely with Sales, Product and Customer Success to generate pipeline, improve buyer engagement, support strategic opportunities and strengthen commercial alignment.

* **Marketing capability:** Maintain strong delivery during the maternity-cover period while introducing a more disciplined planning, reporting, CRM and campaign operating model.

* **Product and sales enablement:** Improve product positioning, launches and buyer messaging, while equipping commercial teams with clearer narratives, campaign tools, proof and market insight.

* **Leadership and team development:** Build credibility with the leadership team, strengthen collaboration across Marketing, Sales and Product, and successfully transition the returning Marketing Manager into a clear and productive team structure.

You are a commercially focused B2B technology marketer who can move confidently between strategy and execution.

You are likely to have worked in a scaling software, SaaS or technology business where marketing needed to become more structured, commercially accountable and influential. You will be comfortable operating with ambiguity, using limited resources intelligently and building strong cross-functional relationships.

**How We Work**

DisplayNote is a growing technology company where marketing is becoming an increasingly important commercial function.

We value people who:

* take ownership

* make decisions using evidence

* work constructively across functions

* move with appropriate speed

* remain close to customers

* use AI intelligently

* improve the system, not just the output

* are willing to challenge established thinking

* care about both commercial performance and customer experience

You will work directly with the CEO, leadership team, Marketing Manager and colleagues across Sales, Product and Customer Success.

We leverage the talent of the people who work here, modern computational techniques and state-of-the-art research infrastructure to analyse large data sets across markets quickly and efficiently, to maximize the effectiveness of our proprietary trading algorithms. We are actively seeking new methods and ideas. The models that drive our trading strategies have evolved considerably over the last 10 years, from econometric methods that gave our company its name, to trees, to neural networks, to modern deep learning architectures.   
  
XTX Markets has an unrivalled level of computational resources in the trading industry, with a growing research cluster currently containing over 25,000 GPUs with more than 1 exabyte of usable storage. Teams across the firm include world-class researchers, developers and technologists with backgrounds in pure math, programming, physics, computer science and machine learning. At XTX Markets technology is our business and we are a diverse organization which attracts outstanding talent from across all industry backgrounds. This role supports the research, evaluation, sourcing, procurement, and commercial management of technology products and services across the entire firm.  
  
A key aspect of the role is staying up to date with emerging technologies, market trends and vendor capabilities, providing technology guidance and strategic recommendations to engineering, infrastructure and business development teams to support the firm’s technology decisions.

* Monitor, review, and evaluate I2P service outputs, methods, procedures, and operational performance to identify root causes, service gaps, and improvement opportunities.

* Build collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and third-party outsourced service providers, where applicable, to ensure clear accountability, effective issue resolution, and consistent service delivery across the region.

* Identify and resolve operational issues across business units, local hubs, shared service teams, and third-party providers, escalating risks and dependencies as needed.

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve efficiency, accuracy, compliance, control effectiveness, and the overall stakeholder experience within accounts payable and invoice-to-pay processes.

* Ensure adherence to SOX controls, company policies, audit requirements, and internal control procedures, including timely follow-through on control gaps, findings, and remediation actions.

* Support automation, system enhancements, break/fix resolution, and process optimization in partnership with internal technical teams, administrative teams, and external solution providers.

* Coordinate internal and external audit requests, ensuring timely response, appropriate documentation, and follow-through on any identified findings or control improvement actions.

* Provide operational input to Global Process Management and Transformation teams to support standardization, future target operating model design, and implementation of shared services improvements.

* Support regional readiness for transformation initiatives, including ERP, Coupa, automation, process standardization, and operating model changes impacting European I2P operations.

* Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned, including supporting backup coverage, special projects, cross-functional initiatives, and occasional regional or international travel as needed.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

* Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in Accounts Payable, Invoice-to-Pay, Procure-to-Pay, Finance Operations, or Shared Services.

* Experience leading teams in a shared services accounts payable or invoice-to-pay environment, preferably across multiple countries or service locations.

* Demonstrated experience leading teams, managing workloads, developing talent, and driving performance in a fast-paced operational environment.

* Strong understanding of end-to-end invoice-to-pay processes, including invoice processing, payment support, supplier issue resolution, compliance controls, reconciliations, SOX, and audit requirements.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify issues, assess root causes, and implement practical process improvements.

* Ability to prioritize tasks, manage deadlines, work with limited oversight, and navigate a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions, regions, and stakeholder groups.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing or partnering with outsourced service providers in a shared services environment.

* Experience working in a multi-country finance operations environment, with exposure to local statutory, regulatory, tax, language, multi-currency, or country-specific considerations impacting invoice-to-pay operations.

* Experience supporting ERP, Coupa, or finance transformation deployments, including operational readiness, hypercare, process stabilization, and change adoption activities.

# Interim Head of Finance - Gibraltar - Contract

## Description

### About Zego

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has.

Good drivers are the entire point of Zego. Seven in 10 drivers on the road are consistently good, but until telematics came along there was no way to prove it, so nearly everyone paid a price based on averages. Zego is the company built to change that.

### **At Zego, we're leading the AI evolution in insurance.**

We move fast, without the layers that usually slow things down. AI takes the routine work off every team, from Finance to Product to Marketing, so people ship real code and launch custom dashboards in minutes. Engineering commits are entirely AI-assisted, which shifts the focus from team size to the quality of your thinking, and our data warehouse connects directly to an AI assistant for instant answers. Backed by a modern tech stack (Claude Code, Snowflake, Figma and Zapier) and a commitment to adopting new tools in days rather than quarters, you get complete ownership to do the most impactful work of your career.

### Purpose of the role

Zego Insurance Limited (ZIL) is the Group's regulated insurance carrier, based in Gibraltar and supervised by the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC). As Interim Head of Finance, you are the ultimate owner of ZIL's financial health, accuracy and operational integrity. Because ZIL underwrites risk on its own balance sheet, the role demands deep, specialised expertise in insurance carrier accounting and technical reserves, not broker or agency finance.

This is a hands-on "player-coach" role. You'll run a lean finance function with one direct report while working in lockstep with the Actuarial team and Group Finance. You'll own the end-to-end financial accounting cycle, ensure strict adherence to Gibraltar and insurance regulatory standards, and design and enforce robust financial controls. As a GFSC-regulated person, you carry personal regulatory responsibility for the accuracy and timeliness of ZIL's financial reporting.

### What you will be doing

**Insurance balance sheet and financial accounting**

* Own the general ledger and the insurance balance sheet in NetSuite, ensuring accurate accounting for premiums, claims, commissions, reinsurance recoveries and profit-share arrangements.
* Lead and execute the month-end and year-end close, producing management accounts (P&L, balance sheet and cash flow) tailored to an insurance carrier, delivered to agreed Group and Board reporting deadlines.
* Prepare and submit annual statutory accounts under UK GAAP (FRS 102) and the applicable Gibraltar Companies Act requirements, and support regulatory returns to the GFSC.
* Ensure all balance sheet accounts, bank and fiduciary accounts, and intercompany balances (including MGA/ZIL positions) are rigorously reconciled every month, with the ledger reconciled to actuarial reserves before submission.

**Actuarial partnership and capital management**

* Act as the bridge between Finance and Actuarial: understand, validate and integrate technical reserve calculations (IBNR, UPR, URR and similar) into the ledgers, and reconcile management accounts to reserving figures.
* Support Solvency II reporting as applied in Gibraltar, including inputs to QRTs, the SFCR and the ORSA, and help monitor capital adequacy so the business maintains appropriate buffers.
* Partner with actuarial, underwriting and pricing teams to analyse loss ratios, combined ratios and profitability by product line, translating technical data into commercial insight for the Board.

**Financial controls, audit and risk**

* Design, implement and enforce robust financial controls and SOPs, particularly around payment approvals, counterparty exposure and credit terms, to prevent fraud and eliminate reconciliation discrepancies.
* Act as the primary point of contact for external auditors and the GFSC. Manage the annual audit end to end, from planning through to sign-off, closing findings and embedding fixes so issues do not recur.
* Ensure timely, accurate filing of corporate taxes and other regulatory financial submissions, working with Group tax where relevant.

**Lean team leadership and operations**

* Directly manage, mentor and develop one finance team member, staying in the detail of the ledger while owning the wider finance agenda.
* Oversee daily cash flow and liquidity, produce rolling cash flow forecasts, and support investment income accounting to ensure claims-paying ability and operational funding.
* Own the ZIL finance system stack (NetSuite), ensuring it integrates cleanly with policy administration and actuarial data to maintain absolute data integrity.

### What you will need to be successful

* A fully qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).
* A proven track record in insurance carrier (balance sheet) accounting. You understand the mechanics of insurance financials; broker or agency-only experience is not sufficient.
* Demonstrated experience working closely with actuaries, and a strong conceptual grasp of reserving, pricing and capital modelling.
* Familiarity with Solvency II reporting (QRT, SFCR, ORSA) and statutory accounts preparation; Gibraltar or comparable small-jurisdiction regulatory experience is an advantage.
* Demonstrable experience building, testing and enforcing internal financial controls.
* Experience managing and developing direct reports in a lean environment, and managing external audits end to end.
* The resilience to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment: you stay calm and effective when priorities shift, without ever letting quality or accuracy slip.
* Willingness and ability to hold a GFSC-approved regulated-person position for ZIL.
* You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

**Bonus points for**

* Big 4 audit experience with an insurance client portfolio.
* Hands-on experience with NetSuite in an insurance or MGA setting.

### What it's like to work at Zego

At Zego, we operate like a high-performing sports team. We come together as one, driven by ambition, backed by real support, and united by a shared mission to win.

Working here means having the backing, the coaching, and an inclusive community of Zegons across the UK and Europe who celebrate your wins and raise your game. It also means holding ourselves to high standards: moving with urgency, taking complete ownership, and embracing honest feedback that helps us continuously learn and evolve.

This is your opportunity for a career-defining experience, and one you will own.

.

### The Zego ways of working

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our central London office weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It is about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It is a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year...

### Benefits

* Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year
* Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution
* Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build
* Private medical insurance, for you and your family
* Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new
* Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact

Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.

Join us and be part of the play!

#### **Position Overview:**

NaturalMotion is looking for a talented and passionate Enemy Designer to join our London studio, helping shape the combat experience for our first-person shooter mobile title. This role focuses on implementing well known enemies, adapting existing enemies and adding new compelling enemies to bring an authentic console experience to mobile

Sitting at the intersection of design, art, animation, audio, and engineering, you will ensure enemy encounters are polished, purposeful and fun. A core responsibility will be working with Level Design & Combat Design to ensure every enemy encounter is polished, purposeful, and fun. We are looking for someone who brings both craft knowledge and a genuine love of action games.

We embrace a hybrid work environment. Within this role you will work 2 days per week in our London office and the remaining days at home.

#### **What You'll Do:**

* Ownership of designing, prototyping, and implementing enemy behaviours, AI systems, boss encounters & other features that align with the creative vision of the game
* Take enemies and bosses from paper design through to shipping quality, ensuring they are complete, polished and fun for players
* Work with Level Design & Combat Design to ensure enemies, factions, and NPCs meet their goals at every stage of development. Define required metrics to track and achieve them
* Collaborate closely with art, animation, audio, design and engineering teams to build content and solve problems in a multi-disciplinary environment
* Develop and balance a diverse roster of enemies, bosses, mutators & more
* Create compelling AI behaviours & attack patterns that provide an exciting experience and appropriately challenging for players
* Analyse combat data, player feedback, and internal playtests to refine and iterate on enemy and boss designs
* Work concurrently on multiple features at varying stages of development, managing priorities effectively as content pipelines run in parallel
* Document and communicate enemy and boss design concepts clearly to ensure alignment across all development teams

#### **What You Bring:**

* Previous experience in Combat / Enemy Design or an equivalent role in the video game industry
* At least one shipped title in a design role for a Shooter / Action / RPG title
* Experience designing and implementing enemy AI, behaviours, and encounters for action games
* Experience working on a first-person or third-person game
* Familiarity with the Unreal game engine
* Ability to analyse gameplay data and player feedback to inform and balance design decisions
* Strong visual & verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across cross-disciplinary teams
* The ability to manage multiple designs in a fast-paced development environment
* Passionate about action games with a deep understanding of what makes enemy designs engaging and memorable

#### **Bonus Points:**

* Background in live service games and/ or mobile games with an understanding of ongoing balancing and content updates
* Experience with visual scripting or rapid prototyping tools
* An avid gamer with a genuine enthusiasm for crafting memorable and inventive enemy designs

#### **What We Offer You:**

* Competitive salary and discretionary annual bonus scheme
* 26 days holiday, plus bank holidays & 2 paid personal days
* 6 months fully paid maternity/adoption leave and 16 weeks fully paid paternity leave (eligibility criteria applies)
* Pension plan, with a double matching employer contribution
* Private medical & dental insurance and healthcare cash plan
* Life insurance, personal accident insurance and income protection
* Mental health and neurodiversity support programs
* Company Employee Stock Purchase Plan (eligibility criteria applies)
* Fitness reimbursement plan, worth £600 per annum
* Flexible working hours
* Weekly happy hours, seasonal parties and monthly social events
* Annual rail season ticket advance and cycle to work scheme
